progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and visit the oracle who has never been wrong. Watch her look through you. Apologize.
Unhappen one great grief, and learn precisely why you will never do it again.
Keep one thing certain — small, secret, yours — as an anchor, or drift.
Stand inside a history as it erases you, and smile at the space.

nodes.name: The Indrawn
nodes.role: Nullification colossus — fire's living absence
nodes.lore: Histories record great fires ending mid-street, and the same hooded figure in each account, centuries apart, inhaling. The Indrawn carry every flame they ever swallowed, still burning, in order, remembered — the library fire, the war-pyres, a candle from a child's window. Scholars dispute whether anything person-shaped remains, or only the inside of a fire, walking.
nodes.playstyle: Walking nullification. Nothing burns within your reach without leave; drink whole conflagrations for power and answer siege-scale magic by simply being where it ends.

abilities.name: Drink the Field
abilities.desc: Inhale every flame, spark, and burning surface in sight; each one banked grants a surge of stored power.

abilities.name: The Ark of Fires
abilities.desc: Kindle the memory of any fire you have ever swallowed — its light, heat, and appetite — without releasing the original.

abilities.name: Kneeling Flame
abilities.desc: Passive — fire will not act against you; enemy flames gutter, lean toward you, and go out apologizing.

abilities.name: Century Lung
abilities.desc: Take any single effect — spell, breath, falling star — wholly into yourself, and hold it there indefinitely.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and end a firestorm the size of a city district in one unbroken breath.
Swallow a Worldpyre's exhalation, or survive refusing to. Histories disagree on which you did.
Let the order examine your chest with mirrors and augurs, and let them find the old library fire inside, still burning, page by page.
Refuse a fire cult's worship politely, twice.

nodes.name: Wyrmwall
nodes.role: Living fortification — army-scale protection
nodes.lore: One northern border is walled for forty miles in overlapping scale, and the wall is warm. Histories dispute whether the Wyrmwall built it or is it; the garrison repairs nothing, because the wall repairs itself, and in hard winters it breathes. Somewhere along those miles stands a human outline where the last scale went — the frontier's softest point, never reached.
nodes.playstyle: Army-scale protection. Extend your plate across formations, walls, and miles; be the fortification the battle happens against, and keep the one gate that is yourself.

abilities.name: Forty-Mile Molt
abilities.desc: Extend your scale along a chosen line to the horizon; it stands as fortress wall until you next sleep.

abilities.name: The Warm Gate
abilities.desc: Open a door shaped like yourself in any wall of yours; who passes is your choice, and the wall remembers faces.

abilities.name: Breathing Battlement
abilities.desc: Passive — fortifications you become or touch repair themselves, run warm, and cannot be tunneled under, because they notice.

abilities.name: Softest Point
abilities.desc: Stand bare at your wall's heart; while you remain its only weakness, no other part of it can fail.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and hold a border alone for one winter as its wall, gates, and garrison.
Give the last scale away, and learn what the human left over is for.
Let a war spend itself against you, then count what you kept standing, not what you broke.
Stay so long the maps mark you. Correct their spelling once.

nodes.name: The Sudden
nodes.role: Execution incarnate — the unannounced end
nodes.lore: Coroners four centuries apart record the same signature: clear day, one mark, no sound reported. Histories treat the Sudden as a family, a curse, or a superstition of well-guarded men, because the alternative is a single person for whom every open sky is the same sky. Guards do not fail against the Sudden. They finish blinking.
nodes.playstyle: Be the moment between safe and struck. Exist only at points of contact, unfindable between them, and end engagements that never learn they began.

abilities.name: Same Sky
abilities.desc: All open sky is one place to you; step from any point beneath it to any other, arriving as the strike.

abilities.name: Finished Blinking
abilities.desc: Passive — nothing may react to your first action in a battle, since the battle begins after it lands.

abilities.name: Cloudless Alibi
abilities.desc: You are verifiably elsewhere until the instant of contact; the world backfills your journey afterward, poorly.

abilities.name: One Mark
abilities.desc: Your strike leaves a single mark and takes a single life, regardless of armor, contingencies, or how certain the survival was.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and end a crowned tyrant at noon, in the open, before the taster has swallowed.
Let scholars prove you are four different people. Provide the fourth's alibi yourself.
Spare one target at the moment of contact, and let them spend a lifetime explaining the weather.
Never be seen arriving. The day you are, retire.

nodes.name: The Decided
nodes.role: Outcome authority — inevitability made present
nodes.lore: Around most legends the histories multiply; around the Decided they converge, every source suddenly agreeing, which frightens archivists more than any contradiction. Nothing near them stays pending. Coins land before the flip; harvests come in at the number already written in the margin. Whether they decide outcomes or merely attend them is the one question left open.
nodes.playstyle: Inevitability control. Declare results and let causality do the paperwork; strip randomness from enemies who live on it, and stand immune to every gamble in reach.

abilities.name: Already Landed
abilities.desc: Passive — all randomness within reach resolves instantly and permanently; nothing near you may be rerolled, hedged, or hoped at.

abilities.name: The Agreed Version
abilities.desc: Declare aloud what is about to happen; every account, including reality's, converges on yours.

abilities.name: Margin Number
abilities.desc: Fix the exact result of the next effect, yours or an enemy's, before it occurs; the number is honored.

abilities.name: No Further Bets
abilities.desc: Remove one enemy's access to chance entirely; their lucky escapes and miracle recoveries are no longer among their outcomes.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and call a kingdom's harvest, war, and succession a year ahead, publicly, to the digit.
Cancel a Hazard Saint's miracle by having scheduled its failure the previous spring.
Keep one thing you never decided — small, wild, yours — or calcify.
Let the archives converge on you, and correct not one word.

nodes.name: The False Dawn
nodes.role: Horizon-scale erasure — light before the sun
nodes.lore: The last Worldpyre's pyre did not go out; it went up. There is a light now that comes before sunrise, listed separately in the almanacs, and farmers wake by it, and armies disband under it. The False Dawn is that light — still technically a person, still on two kingdoms' registries, filed under weather by clerks who prefer not to specify.
nodes.playstyle: Fight as the world's second light. Appear on the horizon before you exist anywhere, burn at dawn-scale, and end wars by the act of rising.

abilities.name: Second Sunrise
abilities.desc: Break over the horizon ahead of the sun; for a span, every fire on the field is dawn, and dawn is yours.

abilities.name: Cartographer's Grief
abilities.desc: Convert all terrain in sight to level glass; the new maps are the surveyors' problem.

abilities.name: The Lit Rim
abilities.desc: Passive — you are visible from a day's march in every direction, and everything that sees you understands exactly what it sees.

abilities.name: Gentle Morning
abilities.desc: Choose one place inside your light to spare; until dusk, nothing and no one can burn it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and let your pyre light itself while you still need the body. Step off it, lit.
Spend a year as the light the farmers wake by, and scorch nothing.
Be surveyed as terrain, taxed as territory, and answer the assessors politely.
Set, once. See what the world does with the dark. Rise anyway.

nodes.name: The Inheritance
nodes.role: Bloodline sovereign — dominion through descent
nodes.lore: The Ancestor waited ahead of the bloodline; the Inheritance is the bloodline. No single body holds them now — they are what the blood carries: the mountain every gifted child sees from above, the heat in a stranger's spit, the luck that runs in families. Genealogists tracing any sorcerer back far enough arrive at the same name, and stop publishing.
nodes.playstyle: Dynastic presence. Fight through the gift itself — kindle, steady, or still the blood of every sorcerous creature present, ally and enemy alike, as family business.

abilities.name: Seen From Above
abilities.desc: Passive — every carrier of the gift has dreamed you; sorcerous enemies fight you without a whole heart.

abilities.name: Kindle the Line
abilities.desc: Wake the dormant gift in any creature's blood for one battle; it surges loyal to you first.

abilities.name: Call the Gift Home
abilities.desc: Silence one inherited power mid-cast and take it into yourself, already lit.

abilities.name: The Long Bequest
abilities.desc: Die, and choose where along the line the whole of you wakes; the world calls this succession, not death.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be dreamed, on the same night, by every gifted child on the continent.
Attend a descendant's naming-day unrecognized, and leave the granary standing.
Let go of the one body. The blood has room.
Answer a genealogist's letter honestly. Enclose nothing flammable.

nodes.name: The Fifth Season
nodes.role: Living season — continental weather sovereignty
nodes.lore: The Standing Storm dispersed one last time and never fully regathered; what gathers instead is a season. Almanacs in the affected provinces now print five, the fifth arriving without date and staying as long as grief requires. Farmers do not curse it. It remembers roofs, mercies, and every place that once made it rain gently.
nodes.playstyle: Season-scale control. Battlefields do not host you; they occur inside your weather. Dictate climate across provinces and let the sky conduct the actual fighting.

abilities.name: Out of Calendar
abilities.desc: Arrive as weather no forecast can hold; every plan, ambush, and divination that relied on the sky simply fails.

abilities.name: Remembered Roofs
abilities.desc: Passive — no storm of yours harms what you have once chosen to spare; the sky keeps your lists.

abilities.name: Harvest of Lightning
abilities.desc: Seed a province's clouds across the season, then reap every stored bolt at once, wherever you are standing.

abilities.name: Blood Weather
abilities.desc: Passive — the season runs in your family; wherever your kin bleed, your weather is already overhead.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and stay dispersed past all reassembly, until the sky keeps your shape out of habit.
Be added to the almanacs as a season, over the astronomers' objections.
Skip one year over the province that prayed loudest, and let them consider what the praying is for.
Rain gently, again, on the place that wronged you. Make it a custom.

nodes.name: The Exception
nodes.role: Standing exemption — reality's sole caveat
nodes.lore: Natural law is written in general terms, and in the fine print of each one there is now a name-shaped gap. The Exception is what the Unfated became when probability stopped withdrawing and formally recused itself. Scholars end their proofs 'save one.' So, more quietly, do gods.
nodes.playstyle: Exemption warfare. Rules, physics, and fates apply to everyone else; walk through consequences selectively and extend your fine print, briefly, to allies about to be ruled against.

abilities.name: Save One
abilities.desc: Passive — every rule, law, spell, and certainty operating on the field applies to everyone but you.

abilities.name: Recusal
abilities.desc: One law of nature declines involvement in the current battle — gravity, fire's heat, the straightness of arrows.

abilities.name: Extended Caveat
abilities.desc: Write an ally into your fine print until dawn; nothing sworn, written, or foretold can hold them.

abilities.name: The General Case
abilities.desc: Rejoin the rules for a single act; the world, out of sheer relief, lets that act succeed completely.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be formally recused by probability, witnessed by an oracle, a court, and a falling stone that reconsiders.
Read the fine print of a divine decree and find your name already exempted, in an older hand.
Break no rule for a decade. Exemption is not appetite.
Leave one law you still obey, unnamed, so you and the world stay on speaking terms.

nodes.name: The Deferred
nodes.role: Suspended cataclysm — fire's absolute custody
nodes.lore: One breath now holds every fire the line ever swallowed, and every fire wants out. The world has quietly rearranged itself around the exhale that must never happen: wars relocate, prophets footnote their endings, doomsday sects time their vigils to the Deferred's breathing. Postponement, kept long enough, becomes a kind of mercy the world builds calendars around.
nodes.playstyle: Cosmological deterrent. Fight in fractions of an ending — spend the breath a grain at a time and let every enemy calculate what the whole would cost.

abilities.name: Fraction of the Breath
abilities.desc: Exhale one ten-thousandth of what you hold, enough to erase the engagement in front of you.

abilities.name: Terms of Deferral
abilities.desc: Declare a span in which nothing in sight may end — no flame, no life, no wall — until you permit it.

abilities.name: The Patient Detonation
abilities.desc: Passive — whatever slays you triggers the exhale; everything that reads futures has advised against it.

abilities.name: Ashen Amnesty
abilities.desc: Pardon one swallowed fire and return it exactly where it was taken from, whatever stands there now.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and hold the exhale through your own death and back, so even endings learn to wait on you.
Let three kingdoms draft their treaties around your breathing, and correct none of their arithmetic.
Walk into the world's oldest caldera and swallow what it was saving.
Choose the day. Tell no one. Keep not choosing it, daily.

nodes.name: Worldkeep
nodes.role: World-fortress — final interception of harm
nodes.lore: Wyrmwall held one border; the Worldkeep is what the word wall was practicing for. When catastrophe comes anywhere — flood, horde, falling star — something between it and the people hardens, and the catastrophe is the one that breaks. Strategists no longer plan last stands. There is a standing last stand, and it is a person.
nodes.playstyle: Absolute interception. Harm anywhere near you arrives at you instead; blunt anything, outlast everything, and return each blow with a note on its exact shortfall.

abilities.name: Learned Limit
abilities.desc: Passive — anything that strikes you once can never exceed that blow against you again; the world's arsenal only shrinks.

abilities.name: Interposition
abilities.desc: Appear between any blow and any victim in sight; distance, walls, and timing concede.

abilities.name: Bearing Wall
abilities.desc: Declare one structure, formation, or person load-bearing; until dusk, it cannot be the thing that breaks.

abilities.name: The Insufficient World
abilities.desc: Return any attack to its maker with a precise measure of how far short it fell.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be struck by everything one age can produce — siege, star, god's regret — and remain the direction the survivors ran.
Retire the word unbreakable from three languages by existing.
Find the one blow that could end you. Keep it somewhere safe. Never test it.
Let a child's fist be the only thing to hurt you this century, because you decided it should.

nodes.name: The Long Levin
nodes.role: Trans-historical strike — one bolt, still falling
nodes.lore: A theory suppressed in three universities holds that every clear-sky strike ever recorded is one bolt — loosed before the first storm, threading history, landing where it must. The Long Levin is that bolt's custodian, or its current position; the scholars cannot decide, and the bolt declines to slow down for the seminar.
nodes.playstyle: Fight along time's length. Your strikes may depart years before a battle and arrive during it; seed past and future with landings only you remember scheduling.

abilities.name: Thrown Before Storms
abilities.desc: Loose a strike into history rather than distance; it lands on your target at any moment you have ever witnessed.

abilities.name: Old Light
abilities.desc: Passive — strikes from your past battles remain live; on any former battlefield, the air still answers you.

abilities.name: Scheduled Sky
abilities.desc: Name a place and an hour within the age; the bolt is now on its way, and nothing can be elsewhere enough.

abilities.name: The Oldest Arc
abilities.desc: Channel the original strike for one blow that predates wards, armor, and the concept of shelter.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and take custody of the bolt thrown before the first storm — from its previous keeper, mid-flight.
Land three strikes in centuries you never lived, and leave the folklore uncorrected.
Be denied by three universities and confirmed by every farmer's aunt.
Pick the final landing. Walk there, unhurried, over decades.

nodes.name: The Constant
nodes.role: Fixed point — the world's one invariable
nodes.lore: Every equation the world runs on carries one term that never varies, and the scholars have stopped pretending it is a number. The Constant is the Decided with its last question closed: it no longer decides or attends — it holds still, and everything else moves relative to it. Astronomers correct their tables; sailors take their bearings; empires calibrate.
nodes.playstyle: Absolute reference frame. You do not act so much as remain; battles reorganize around your fixed value, and whatever contradicts you is the thing that changes.

abilities.name: Held Value
abilities.desc: Passive — set your own state at battle's start; nothing may alter it afterward, including you.

abilities.name: Relative Motion
abilities.desc: You do not dodge; the world moves. Every attack's path is recalculated around your unchanged position.

abilities.name: Calibration
abilities.desc: Touch one changing thing — a wound, a rout, a collapsing wall — and fix it at its current value indefinitely.

abilities.name: The Closed Question
abilities.desc: Answer any paradox, prophecy, or wager by existing; effects that require uncertainty fail within your sight.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and hold one value — any value — while a god, a war, and an age try to move it.
Be adopted by the astronomers as a correction and by the sailors as a bearing.
Change nothing for a hundred years, including your mind.
Remain. When everything else has moved, be what it moved relative to.

families.name: Warlock
families.tagline: Power on credit. The interest compounds nightly.
families.description: Every Warlock owns a signature they cannot take back. Some signed for knowledge, some for revenge, one or two for love; all signed. Power arrives on schedule — the price is deferred, compounding, and collected in currencies no one thinks to guard. A Warlock's art is spending borrowed fire faster than the interest accrues, and reading every word before speaking any.

nodes.name: Warlock
nodes.role: Ranged caster — sustained pact damage
nodes.lore: Warlocks are found, not trained. A scholar who read one margin too deep. A farmer who took the fourth road at a three-way crossing. Each carries a pact instead of a pedigree, and power that answers promptly — because prompt service is how a lender keeps a client borrowing. Guilds mistrust them. Lenders never do.
nodes.playstyle: Sustained pact-bolts fueled by a debt meter that recharges when you take risks; spend health, position, or buffs as collateral for bursts of borrowed power.

abilities.name: Umbral Levy
abilities.desc: Fires a bolt of borrowed shadow that deals sustained damage and refunds a sliver of your debt meter on kill.

abilities.name: Witness Mark
abilities.desc: Brands a target as observed by your patron, increasing your damage against it and revealing it through walls.

abilities.name: Borrowed Fire
abilities.desc: Spend health as collateral to double your next spell's damage; the health returns only if the spell kills.

abilities.name: Read the Terms
abilities.desc: Study an enemy for one turn to learn a resistance and gain a shield scaled to what you learned.

progressionSteps: Want something more than you fear the price — enough that the wanting can be heard.
Find the offer: a book that answers back, a crossroads with a fourth road, a dream that leaves ink on your hands.
Sign. With blood, with a name, with the year you would have died happy — but sign.
Cast your first borrowed spell, and feel the interest begin.

nodes.name: Brimstone Advocate
nodes.role: Mid-range controller — burning debuffs and bindings
nodes.lore: Advocates argue with hell in hell's own grammar. They study clause-law in chapterhouses whose libraries smoke faintly, and treat their pact as a live case rather than a settled debt. Devils find them insufferable and, worse, admissible. Their spellbook reads like a brief, and their fires arrive with citations attached.
nodes.playstyle: Mid-range control through burning contract sigils; brand enemies with terms, punish them for breaching, and cash accumulated clauses into sudden hellfire verdicts.

abilities.name: Writ of Immolation
abilities.desc: Serves a burning document upon a target; the flames intensify each turn the target acts against you.

abilities.name: Breach of Terms
abilities.desc: Reaction: when a marked enemy leaves melee or breaks a binding, it detonates for hellfire damage.

abilities.name: Retainer
abilities.desc: A minor fiend on retainer interposes itself before the next three attacks that would strike you.

abilities.name: Fine Print
abilities.desc: Inscribes an invisible clause on the ground; enemies who cross it are rooted and ignited for three turns.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and read your own contract cover to cover, aloud, without weeping at what you find on page nine.
Study clause-law in a chapterhouse of the damned; pass the bar of Dis by burning your examiner's argument, not the examiner.
Win one amendment to your pact before an infernal notary. Lose a small thing you loved as the filing fee.
Brand the sigil of your patron's court onto your casting hand. It is a summons, and you are the paper.

nodes.name: Hollow Listener
nodes.role: Ranged attrition caster — mind erosion
nodes.lore: Listeners turned from hell's tidy ledgers toward the silence between stars, where the terms are never written down. Their patrons pay attention — the payment and the price in a single word. Villages know a Listener by small absences: forgotten anniversaries, misplaced faces. Older Listeners keep journals so they will believe themselves tomorrow.
nodes.playstyle: Attrition caster; stack whisper debuffs that erode enemy accuracy and resolve, phase-step through danger, and trade your own memories for emergency power.

abilities.name: Erosive Truth
abilities.desc: Whispers a fact the target cannot unknow, reducing its accuracy and resolve each time it repeats an action.

abilities.name: Askance
abilities.desc: Step sideways through a direction that is not there, evading the next attack and reappearing behind its source.

abilities.name: Litany of the Rim
abilities.desc: Channels the patron's attention onto an area, dealing growing psychic damage to everything that remains and remembers.

abilities.name: Tuition
abilities.desc: Sacrifice one prepared buff to instantly refresh your longest cooldown; something small about you is different afterward.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and spend nine nights beneath the starless patch in the constellation the charts refuse to name.
Hear the whisper. Do not answer for the first three nights; the eager ones are eaten.
Answer on the fourth. Surrender a memory of your choosing — choose badly, and it chooses next time.
Return to town and note which of your friends no longer recall your face. That is the tuition.

nodes.name: Clausebinder
nodes.role: Summoner-controller — fiend theft and binding
nodes.lore: Every devil is a signatory somewhere, and Clausebinders collect signatures. They hunt original contracts through hell's archives and mortal auction-blocks alike, then bind fiends with their own arrogant fine print. The pit calls the practice heresy; the pit's own lawyers, quietly, call it precedent. A leashed devil is a Clausebinder's letter of introduction.
nodes.playstyle: Summoner-controller; steal enemy summons with countersigned contracts, leash a bound fiend as a persistent companion, and chain foes in place with custody law.

abilities.name: Countersign
abilities.desc: Overwrites the summoning contract of an enemy minion, turning it to your service for the encounter.

abilities.name: Chain of Custody
abilities.desc: Manacles of clause-iron root up to three enemies; bound fiends take double damage from all sources.

abilities.name: Indenture
abilities.desc: Permanently binds one subdued fiend as a companion; it hates you lawfully and fights accordingly well.

abilities.name: Perjurer's Brand
abilities.desc: Marks a target; any deceptive act — feint, blink, or invisibility — stuns it and refunds your spell.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and obtain a devil's true contract — the original, not a copy. Devils die guarding these.
Find the loophole. Every contract has one; the pit writes in arrogance, and arrogance leaves gaps.
Bind the fiend with its own signature and walk it leashed through the market of a mortal city.
Refuse the archdevil's offer to buy your silence. Frame the offer instead.

nodes.name: Cinder Bailiff
nodes.role: Melee-hybrid striker — debt-fueled burst
nodes.lore: When a debt to the pit matures, the Court of Embers dispatches a Bailiff — mortal, branded, and legally indistinguishable from fire. They seize exactly what is owed: a voice, a harvest, an heir's luck. Their restraint is famous and frightening; a Bailiff who takes one breath too many becomes the next collection.
nodes.playstyle: Bruiser-collector; drag debtors into reach, brand them with growing arrears, then repossess health, buffs, and finally the killing blow when the debt matures.

abilities.name: Seizure Order
abilities.desc: Drags a target into melee reach; its shields and wards are held in evidence for the duration.

abilities.name: Brand of Arrears
abilities.desc: Applies a debt that grows each time the target acts; the accrued total lands as fire when you collect.

abilities.name: Repossession
abilities.desc: Strips a buff, a summoned ally, or a portion of health from the target — whichever is currently worth most.

abilities.name: Collector's Toll
abilities.desc: Aura: enemies who strike you owe interest, taking a portion of their own damage dealt as hellfire.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and petition the Court of Embers for a collector's brand-iron. Petitions are heard in the flame; kneel close.
Collect your first defaulted soul from a debtor who begs. Take exactly what is owed, and not one breath more.
Collect the second from a debtor with an army.
Burn a ledger page bearing a name you love, so the court knows your hand will not shake.

nodes.name: Anglewright
nodes.role: Battlefield warper — zone control and displacement
nodes.lore: The patron showed them angles, and the angles were true; that was the horror. Anglewrights memorize eleven forbidden diagrams and reproduce them in doorways, siege-lines, and sleep. Architects pay ruinous fees to have them certify a fortress cannot fold. Nobody pays them to make one that can. They fold anyway.
nodes.playstyle: Zone warper; fold the battlefield so corridors reroute and cover lies, collapse proofs onto grouped enemies, and exit any fight through a wrong angle.

abilities.name: Wrong Angle
abilities.desc: Redirects a projectile mid-flight along a fold, returning it to its origin by a route that never crossed the room.

abilities.name: Folded Floor
abilities.desc: Creases the terrain so two distant points touch; allies step across instantly, enemies arrive somewhere narrower.

abilities.name: Close the Figure
abilities.desc: Completes a diagram over an area; the enclosed space implodes, crushing everything toward its provable center.

abilities.name: Impossible Interior
abilities.desc: Opens a room that is larger inside than out; allies shelter there for one turn that lasts longer.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and copy the eleven forbidden diagrams from memory, in one sitting, in a room with no corners.
Fold your first door: walk into a wall and out of a stranger's shadow a mile away.
Spend one night inside an angle. Come out with your name still in the right order.
Map a temple so its own priests can no longer find the altar. Leave before the geometry does.

nodes.name: Void Antiphon
nodes.role: Support-debuffer — wards and name erosion
nodes.lore: The whisper is a call; the Antiphon is the answer. These warlocks learned the response verse by verse, paying in memories they chose and some they did not. Congregations of one, they steady allies with borrowed calm and unpick enemies syllable by syllable. Their singing voice is beautiful now. It is also not theirs.
nodes.playstyle: Support-debuffer; echo verses that ward allies while eroding enemy names, stripping titles, buffs, and certainties until foes forget how to fight.

abilities.name: Response Verse
abilities.desc: Echoes the patron's call as a blessing, granting nearby allies a calm that absorbs fear, charm, and despair.

abilities.name: Name Erosion
abilities.desc: Sings a syllable out of the target's name, stripping one title, buff, or aspect with each verse.

abilities.name: Descant of Dread
abilities.desc: A high thin harmony only enemies hear; those below half resolve flee toward the nearest dark.

abilities.name: Choir of One
abilities.desc: Splits your voice across three positions; each may cast your whispers independently for two turns.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and learn the call by heart — all of it, though hearts were not built to hold it.
Sing the response alone in an empty cathedral until the emptiness sings the verse back.
Speak one eroding truth to a tyrant and watch a certainty leave his eyes forever.
Give up the memory of your own singing voice. What replaces it is not yours, and it is better.

nodes.name: Censor of Dis
nodes.role: Elite controller — ability deletion and dispels
nodes.lore: A handful of binders have entered the Iron Archive where hell's living contracts hang like carcasses, and left with editorial authority. Censors strike clauses from documents that scream. Archdevils reroute wars around their signatures. Each carries a stylus of accounting-iron that never runs dry, because the ink is drawn from the margin of their own pact.
nodes.playstyle: Elite control; delete one enemy ability per battle by redaction, void enchantment fields, and rewrite ongoing effects as amendments favoring your side.

abilities.name: Iron Ink
abilities.desc: Draws a line of iron ink through one enemy ability, deleting it for the remainder of the encounter.

abilities.name: Null and Void
abilities.desc: Voids all enchantments, blessings, and contracts in an area — including, briefly and dangerously, your own.

abilities.name: Amendment
abilities.desc: Rewrites an ongoing effect on the field, changing its beneficiary to a target of your choosing.

abilities.name: Archive Key
abilities.desc: Summons a door of the Iron Archive; allies who pass through emerge with one cooldown refreshed.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and enter the Iron Archive of Dis — by writ, by breach, or by being subpoenaed and refusing to leave.
Strike a single clause from a living contract, and survive the archdevil whose power that clause was.
Redact your patron's claim on one hour of your future. Spend it however you like; you have earned exactly one.
Leave the Archive with ink on your hands that the pit cannot account for.

nodes.name: Pyre Executor
nodes.role: Elite executioner — delayed dooms and executes
nodes.lore: Executors preside over the estates of the damned: soul-holdings so vast the pit cannot burn them without procedure. They build nine-tiered pyres, hear final appeals, and enforce rulings even hell contests. Their arrival is a formality in the worst sense — the sentence was passed the moment they were sent, and the fire is paperwork.
nodes.playstyle: Elite executioner; place delayed maturity dooms, burn crowds of lesser enemies in procedural pyres, and execute any target that falls below the debt threshold.

abilities.name: Maturity Date
abilities.desc: Stamps a doom that falls due in three turns, dealing damage equal to everything the target did meanwhile.

abilities.name: Writ of Execution
abilities.desc: Instantly executes a target below one-quarter health; the estate's remaining souls transfer to your debt meter.

abilities.name: Procedural Pyre
abilities.desc: Erects a nine-tiered pyre zone; lesser enemies inside burn in strict order of their outstanding balance.

abilities.name: Ash Settlement
abilities.desc: Converts a defeated enemy into ash payment, healing allies and issuing each a receipt of minor warding.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and accept appointment as executor over an estate of ten thousand damned souls.
Preside over a default the pit itself contests. Rule against the pit. Enforce the ruling.
Build the procedural pyre with your own hands: nine tiers, one for each circle owed.
Execute a writ against a hell-prince's own collateral. Deliver ash, and a receipt.

nodes.name: Refutant
nodes.role: Elite warper — rule suspension and counterspells
nodes.lore: Each Refutant has published one disproof: a demonstrated contradiction in the world's founding geometry. Parallel lines that met. A whole smaller than its part. The wizard colleges burn their treatises on sight and cannot say why the ash falls upward. Reality treats a Refutant as errata — annoying, footnoted, and irremovably true.
nodes.playstyle: Rule-breaker; suspend one battlefield law at a time — gravity, distance, sequence — counterspell by contradiction, and crush enemies between lines made to meet.

abilities.name: Postulate Zero
abilities.desc: Suspends one physical law in an area — gravity, momentum, or distance — for two turns; you are exempt.

abilities.name: Reductio
abilities.desc: Extends an enemy's power to its absurd conclusion, converting its strongest buff into an equivalent penalty.

abilities.name: Parallel Made to Meet
abilities.desc: Draws two converging lines through the battlefield; everything caught between is crushed at the meeting point.

abilities.name: Disproof
abilities.desc: Counterspell by contradiction: the interrupted spell resolves as though it had never been possible, refunding nothing.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and choose one axiom the world rests on. Study it until you find where it lies.
Publish the disproof by demonstration: make two parallel lines meet, and stand where they cross.
Survive the correction, when the world sends its geometry to argue.
Refuse the colleges when they come to burn your proof. Let them measure your shadow and find it disagreeing.

nodes.name: Cantor of Erasure
nodes.role: Elite debuffer — silence zones and action erasure
nodes.lore: The full antiphon has verses no throat should carry, and Cantors carry them anyway, spaced with silences out of mercy. They trade languages for verses and remember each trade as a blank page. Kingdoms retain Cantors to unsay treaties, heresies, and on one occasion a war. What they erase does not become forgotten; it becomes never.
nodes.playstyle: Elite debuffer; blanket zones in unsinging silence, erase an enemy's most recent action, and spread a rot that eats abilities out of their lexicon.

abilities.name: Threnody Gap
abilities.desc: Blankets a zone in unsinging silence; spellcasting, commands, and battle-cries fail inside it.

abilities.name: Unsung Verse
abilities.desc: Erases the target's most recent action, undoing its effects and returning any cost paid as confusion.

abilities.name: Lexicon Rot
abilities.desc: Infects a target with spreading forgetting; each turn it loses one word, then the abilities those words held up.

abilities.name: Rest Note
abilities.desc: Holds one enemy inside a musical rest, removed from time until the measure ends or it is struck.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and recover a verse of the antiphon from a monastery whose monks all died mid-sentence.
Sing it once, entire, to an audience of one condemned volunteer. Record what remains.
Learn the rest gap by gap, trading a language you speak for each. Keep your mother tongue for last.
Perform the Erasure Round beneath the patron's regard, and remain a someone when the song ends.

nodes.name: Manumitter
nodes.role: Elite liberator — unbinding and freed-fiend allies
nodes.lore: The Censors edit hell's paper; Manumitters burn it. Each freed fiend walks away owing nothing enforceable — which is the point. Gratitude has no maturity date, no loophole, no court of appeal. The pit calls the practice theft. The freed call it nothing at all; they simply arrive when a Manumitter is outnumbered.
nodes.playstyle: Liberation support; burn enemy binding-contracts to turn minions free-willed and friendly, cleanse allies of marks and controls, and cash gratitude into unpurchased rescues.

abilities.name: Burn the Paper
abilities.desc: Destroys the contract binding an enemy minion; freed, it owes you nothing and fights for you anyway.

abilities.name: Off the Books
abilities.desc: Strikes an ally from every enemy ledger, ending all marks, brands, curses, and targeting effects upon them.

abilities.name: Debt of Gratitude
abilities.desc: Passive: creatures you have freed fight harder beside you than anything bound ever fought, gaining damage against their former masters.

abilities.name: Empty the Cells
abilities.desc: Breaks every root, bind, and dominance effect on the field; beings released this way spend one turn choosing sides.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and enter the Iron Archive as the Censors do — carrying flint instead of a stylus.
Burn one living contract entire, and face what steps out of the ash with no terms left to hold it.
Ask nothing of it. This is the entire discipline, and most fail here.
Leave a standing fire in the Archive that consumes one page a year. Let the pit budget for it.

nodes.name: Factor of Embers
nodes.role: Elite drain-tank — perpetual siphons and death denial
nodes.lore: Executors close accounts; Factors keep them open. The Court of Embers licenses a few collectors to farm what they could burn — debtors kept solvent, paying, and alive with a professional tenderness that frightens harder men. A Factor's ledger has no final column. Ask one when a debt ends, and you will get the smile.
nodes.playstyle: Drain-sustain bruiser; attach small siphons to everything, deny enemies the mercy of dying, and grow stronger for every round an account stays open.

abilities.name: Peppercorn Rent
abilities.desc: Attaches a tiny siphon to each enemy; individually negligible, collectively your health and power income for the encounter.

abilities.name: Compounded Nightly
abilities.desc: Doubles all your active siphons on any target that failed to remove one since your last turn.

abilities.name: Performing Asset
abilities.desc: Declares a dying enemy an asset: it cannot drop below one health while you extract from it each round.

abilities.name: Sponging-House
abilities.desc: Erects a holding-house zone; enemies below half health inside cannot leave, die, or heal until their balance clears.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and return your brand-iron to the Court of Embers. Ask instead for a license to keep what burns.
Hold a soul above the fire for a year without letting it burn. Collect every day. This is the aptitude test.
Refuse an order of execution on a profitable account, and defend the refusal before the court in the flame.
Open a ledger with no final column. Show it to a Pyre Executor, and do not flinch at what they call you.

nodes.name: Annexwright
nodes.role: Elite zone-builder — conjured rooms and enclosures
nodes.lore: Refutants hold that the diagrams condemn the world; Annexwrights read them as building permits. They raise rooms creation never zoned — cellars beneath battlefields, stairs into standing armies — and every brick is borrowed. The patron holds the deed to each impossible interior. Annexwrights build anyway, magnificently, like debtors furnishing a mortgaged house.
nodes.playstyle: Architectural controller; grow rooms onto the battlefield that shelter allies and swallow enemies, connect them with hidden doors, and pay the mortgage in risk.

abilities.name: Break Ground
abilities.desc: Lays a foundation glyph; over two turns a room assembles around it, walls first, granting cover and then enclosure.

abilities.name: Mortgaged Masonry
abilities.desc: Raises instant walls of borrowed stone; each panel destroyed transfers a stack of debt to whoever broke it.

abilities.name: Servants' Door
abilities.desc: Opens a discreet door between any two of your rooms; allies pass freely, and nothing else finds the handle.

abilities.name: Windowless Study
abilities.desc: Encloses one enemy in a study with no windows; it may leave when it has read everything.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and submit plans for a room the world lacks: state purpose, dimensions, and collateral.
Build your first annex where a siege will find it. Quarter the defenders in a cellar the attackers' maps deny.
Sign the mortgage. The patron holds the deed to every room you raise; read what the foreclosure clause says, twice.
Furnish one room with things you cannot afford to lose. Live in it. Build better because you do.

nodes.name: Keeper of the Refrain
nodes.role: Elite anchor-support — persistence wards and revival
nodes.lore: Cantors believe the antiphon is a knife; Keepers know it is a dam. Somewhere the response must always be singing, or the starless patch widens — so the order sings in relays, in borrowed voices, without one missed measure in four centuries. They ward what the void would unsay. The rota has no retirements.
nodes.playstyle: Anchor-support; channel verses that make allies impossible to erase, silence, or rename, re-sing the fallen, and hold every ward at once while singing.

abilities.name: Hold the Note
abilities.desc: Channels a sustained verse; allies within it cannot be erased, renamed, silenced, or removed from the record.

abilities.name: Fermata
abilities.desc: Extends one beneficial effect on an ally indefinitely; it lasts exactly as long as you keep singing.

abilities.name: Sing Them Back
abilities.desc: Re-sings a fallen ally's name from memory; they rise with health equal to the verses you have left.

abilities.name: Pass the Verse
abilities.desc: Passes your active channel to a willing ally's mouth for two turns, freeing you to cast while they hold it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and stand the novice watch: four nights of singing, no verse repeated, no verse dropped.
Miss nothing. The watch before yours missed one measure in the year of the red comet; count what the sky lost.
Learn the rota's names, living and dead. You will sing beside all of them eventually.
Take the dawn watch alone. When the Cantors tell you the song is a weapon, keep singing; that is the whole rebuttal.

nodes.name: Final Signatory
nodes.role: Mythic controller — battlefield-wide rule imposition
nodes.lore: There is one seat at hell's every negotiation that is never offered and always filled. The Final Signatory holds more infernal paper in escrow than the Nine Courts combined, priced the peace between two warring hells, and keeps their own original pact framed, unpaid, and eternally in dispute. Archdevils schedule appointments. The Signatory does not keep them.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic controller; impose battle-wide terms all combatants obey, escrow the strongest enemy out of the fight, and countersign allies' abilities to duplicate them.

abilities.name: Terms Absolute
abilities.desc: Imposes battle-wide terms — no summoning, no healing, or no retreat — that every combatant, allies included, must obey.

abilities.name: Escrow of Kings
abilities.desc: Seals the strongest enemy in a neutral vault outside the fight until you release it or fall.

abilities.name: Signature Required
abilities.desc: Nothing enters or leaves the battlefield — reinforcements, teleports, fleeing souls — without your countersignature.

abilities.name: The Disputed Original
abilities.desc: Once per day, invoke your own unpaid pact to refuse a death; the dispute over who owns you continues.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 holding more infernal contracts in escrow than any devil holds mortal souls.
When the Nine Courts convene to void your holdings, attend uninvited. Table the master pact they thought was burned.
Countersign the peace between two warring hells, and price your signature so neither can ever afford war again.
Frame your own contract, unpaid and eternally disputed, in a hall where archdevils wait for appointments you do not keep.

nodes.name: Ninth Flame
nodes.role: Mythic striker — scaling foreclosure damage
nodes.lore: Eight flames of the pit burn tithes, tribute, and the routinely damned. The ninth burns collateral — the things debtors could not bear to lose — and it walks now in a borrowed body that was once a warlock. The hells list the Ninth Flame in their ledgers under assets. The entry has been corrected, in ash, to creditor.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic striker; damage scales with everything the target values, interest doubles each round, and foreclosure claims defeated souls as fuel for city-burning flame.

abilities.name: Collateral Burn
abilities.desc: Ignites what the target values most; damage scales with its buffs, minions, and remaining hope.

abilities.name: Balance Due
abilities.desc: A burn that doubles each round it goes unpaid; extinguishing it costs the target its strongest ability.

abilities.name: Collect in Full
abilities.desc: Executes a burning target and claims its soul as fuel, permanently increasing your flame by a fraction.

abilities.name: Tithe of Cities
abilities.desc: Once per siege, taxes an entire district in fire, sparing exactly those who owe you nothing.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 with the brand of every circle scarred over your heart, and let the eighth flame find you wanting nothing.
Walk into the furnace where defaulted worlds are burned. Do not come out. Become what comes out.
Burn a debt so old the pit had forgotten it was owed — and collect.
Let the hells open a ledger in your name. When they list you as an asset, correct the entry: creditor.

nodes.name: The Unfolded
nodes.role: Mythic warper — extradimensional evasion and assassination
nodes.lore: They stepped through their own proof and returned with directions no one else possesses. Seen from the east, a person; from an angle without a name, a corridor with weather. Cartographers who chart the Unfolded produce maps that chart the cartographer. Where they linger, rooms acquire extra insides, and locked doors become a matter of opinion.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic evasion-warper; occupy surplus directions no attack can follow, tessellate into simultaneous selves, and kill from angles that do not exist yet.

abilities.name: Surplus Direction
abilities.desc: Move along a direction only you possess; attacks, walls, and line-of-sight cannot follow the route.

abilities.name: Tessellate
abilities.desc: Unfolds into simultaneous selves tiling the battlefield; each acts once, then the pattern decides which was real.

abilities.name: Perspective Kill
abilities.desc: Strikes from an angle that does not exist at the target's location, ignoring armor, cover, and witnesses.

abilities.name: Room With No Inside
abilities.desc: Encloses enemies in a space that has an outside only; they exist nowhere until the geometry relents.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and write the proof of yourself: every angle you contain, every direction you have earned.
Step through the proof.
Return by an angle that did not exist when you left. Bring back one impossible room, and live in it.
Allow the cartographers one glimpse. When their maps of you burn themselves, the folding is complete.

nodes.name: The Unword
nodes.role: Mythic unmaker — existence-level debuffs
nodes.lore: The antiphon is complete, and what finished it wears the singer lightly. The Unword is spoken of in careful synonyms, because languages near it keep losing their nouns. It no longer hears the patron's whisper; the whisper issues from it, patient and grammatical. Histories leave a blank page where its deeds should be. The page is accurate.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic unmaker; silence precedes you, words fail around you, and the antiphon's final verse briefly removes an enemy from existence's page entirely.

abilities.name: First Silence
abilities.desc: Radiates the silence that preceded language; enemy abilities with names cease to function within it.

abilities.name: The Blank Page
abilities.desc: Removes an enemy from the record for two turns; every effect it caused this battle is suspended with it.

abilities.name: Antiphon Complete
abilities.desc: Sings the final verse once per day; a chosen enemy is unwritten, leaving a gap that legends form around.

abilities.name: Careful Synonym
abilities.desc: Allies speak of you sideways and gain a ward; enemies who name you directly take psychic backlash.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 with the whole antiphon learned and every memory it cost already spent.
Sing the call and the response together, alone, in the place where the starless patch touches the sea.
Let the patron finish the verse through your mouth. What survives of you may keep the body.
Unspeak one word from every language at once. Choose mercy: make it a small word. They will still write legends around the gap.

nodes.name: The Jubilee
nodes.role: Mythic liberator — mass unbinding and turned legions
nodes.lore: Every fiftieth year, hell's ledgers observe an hour of dread. The Jubilee is why. Where it walks, bindings rot, indentures blank, and things long owned remember their own names. Freed legions attend it uncontracted, unpaid, unbiddable — and absolute. One signature in creation resists it: its own, framed in the pit, still accruing.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic liberator; shatter every binding on the field, convert freed minions into devoted irregulars, and ring in a year where no chain holds.

abilities.name: General Release
abilities.desc: Discharges every binding, contract, charm, and summons on the battlefield in one bell-stroke; nothing remains owned.

abilities.name: The Freed Hundred
abilities.desc: Calls no one; a hundred things you once freed simply arrive, fight one battle, and leave unthanked.

abilities.name: No Masters Here
abilities.desc: Aura: commands fail, dominance breaks, and enemy minions within it gain the option — most take it.

abilities.name: Ring the Year
abilities.desc: Once per day, declares the year of release: allies' cooldowns clear, debts zero, and everything built on obligation collapses.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 with more freed names in your wake than any court holds bound.
Empty a circle of the pit in a single night. Take no oaths of thanks; oaths are the thing you are against.
Stand before your own framed signature and burn every contract in the room except it. Understand, finally, the price of the bell you have become.
Let the freed name a year after you. When the ledgers of hell schedule their dread around it, ring.

nodes.name: The Perpetuity
nodes.role: Mythic attrition engine — compounding universal tribute
nodes.lore: Kingdoms audit their oldest budgets and find it: a line-item no minister remembers approving, payable quarterly, since before the kingdom. The Perpetuity was mortal once; the Factors dispute which one. It does not attack so much as accrue. Armies sent against it return smaller each season, on schedule, and the schedule is the weapon.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic attrition; everything on the field pays you each round, damage taken becomes principal owed back, and you cannot die while anything still owes.

abilities.name: Quitrent
abilities.desc: Levies a token from every enemy each round — health, a buff-second, a step of movement; the tokens compound.

abilities.name: Added to Principal
abilities.desc: Converts damage you take into debt the attacker owes; it repays automatically, with interest, at the start of each round.

abilities.name: In Perpetuity
abilities.desc: Passive: your drains, brands, and siphons never expire, never cap, and survive their target's death onto the next of kin.

abilities.name: Outstanding
abilities.desc: Passive: while any debt to you remains outstanding, so do you — you cannot be reduced below one health.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 holding open accounts older than the nations that owe them.
Attach one imperceptible levy to an empire's founding charter. Collect for a century before an auditor's grandchild notices.
When the empire sends its armies to close the account, tax the campaign itself: every march, every ration, every prayer.
Outlive the auditor, the dynasty, and the language the debt was written in. Renew the terms in whatever tongue replaces it.

nodes.name: The Hidden Wing
nodes.role: Mythic architect — pocket-realm deployment and shelter
nodes.lore: Behind the world's walls runs a wing the surveyors miss: mile-long galleries, guest rooms for the hunted, doors that open off the backs of wardrobes and worse. One Annexwright built it, mortgage upon mortgage. The builder keeps the single room the patron's deed forgot to name, and does not sleep well in it.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic architect; unfold whole rooms of your wing onto any battlefield, route allies through friendly corridors, and fight indoors on ground you own — almost.

abilities.name: Open the Wing
abilities.desc: Unfolds a stretch of your hidden wing over the field; the terrain becomes your corridors, and you know every door.

abilities.name: Room and Board
abilities.desc: Quarters allies in a recovery room between turns; they heal, and something in the kitchen feeds them.

abilities.name: Enfilade
abilities.desc: Aligns the doorways of every room you have deployed; one attack travels through all of them at once.

abilities.name: House Rules
abilities.desc: Inside your rooms, you set one rule per battle — no teleports, no fire, no dying — binding all guests.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 with more rooms to your name than the name on the deeds — which is not yours, and never was.
Build the wing a new gallery every year, and pay the year's interest in whatever the patron's letter names.
Shelter a hundred hunted strangers in rooms no pursuer can survey. Charge nothing. The mortgage is heavier that way, and better.
Find the room the deed forgot. Move in before the patron's clerks amend the paperwork.

nodes.name: The Watchsong
nodes.role: Mythic sustainer — unbroken wards and deathless channel
nodes.lore: The rota failed in the plague years; the relays died mid-verse. One Keeper took the whole watch and has not stopped singing since — through wars, winters, and once, famously, a beheading the song declined to recognize. While the Watchsong holds, the starless patch does not widen. Histories dispute the singer. The song is not disputed.
nodes.playstyle: Mythic sustainer; one endless channel carries every ward you know, allies spend verses instead of dying, and unmaking effects strike the song, not its targets.

abilities.name: Watch Entire
abilities.desc: Maintains every ward you know on every ally simultaneously, sustained by the one song you never stop singing.

abilities.name: Spent Verse
abilities.desc: When an ally would fall, a verse of the antiphon is spent instead; the antiphon is long, not endless.

abilities.name: Answer for Them
abilities.desc: Erasure, unmaking, and name-eating effects targeting allies are intercepted by the song and dissipate into harmony.

abilities.name: The Old Voices
abilities.desc: Once per day, dead Keepers take the watch for one measure; you act freely, twice, while they hold it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 singing a watch that has no relief scheduled, and want no relief.
Sing through your first war without a dropped measure. Sing the second one quieter, so the dying can hear it.
When the blade falls, keep the verse. What survives a beheading is whichever of you the song was holding.
Teach the rota nothing. Let them believe the watch still rotates; hope is also a ward.

nodes.name: The Quorum
nodes.role: Apotheosis controller — procedural sovereignty over battle
nodes.lore: The Signatory stopped keeping appointments; the appointments adjusted. Now no court convenes, no pact concludes, no war is lawfully declared anywhere unless the Quorum is present — and it is always present, the way noon is present. The person retired to the hall of waiting archdevils. The office attends everything, and everything waits its turn.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis controller; battles require your presence to proceed, you set the order of every round, and enemy actions fail for lack of a second.

abilities.name: Called to Order
abilities.desc: The battle cannot begin, end, or escalate without your acknowledgment; each round opens in the order you set.

abilities.name: Motion Denied
abilities.desc: Counters any action, spell, or command; it fails for lack of a second, and its cost is not returned.

abilities.name: Revise the Minutes
abilities.desc: Once per battle, corrects the record of the previous round; the round is re-decided as you minuted it.

abilities.name: Proxy
abilities.desc: Grants an ally your standing for one round; they may cast one of your abilities with your full procedural authority.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and stop attending. Anything that truly requires you will learn to convene where you already are.
Let your presence become procedural: a line on every summons, a chair at every table, drawn before the agenda.
Miss nothing by attending nothing. When two hells declare war and the declaration fails for want of you, note it in the minutes.
Leave the body in the hall where archdevils wait. It is the office they make appointments with now, and the office is everywhere.

nodes.name: The Foreclosure
nodes.role: Apotheosis striker — terminal fire of default
nodes.lore: The Ninth Flame burned collateral; the Foreclosure is what the burning became. When a world's debt matures past all forbearance, the sky there turns a color bookkeepers recognize, and this office arrives as weather. Hell's ledgers list it now as neither asset nor creditor but as the closing entry — the line drawn under everything.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis striker; appraise everything an enemy is, call the whole balance due at once, and settle battlefields with fire that closes accounts permanently.

abilities.name: Notice of Default
abilities.desc: Posts notice upon a target; for three turns everything it does, gains, or holds is appraised and added to the balance.

abilities.name: Past Forbearance
abilities.desc: Collects any noticed enemy whose balance exceeds its remaining health; the difference burns outward toward its allies.

abilities.name: Creditor Sky
abilities.desc: Repossesses the sky above the enemy line; what falls from it afterward is fire, on a payment schedule.

abilities.name: Vacant Possession
abilities.desc: Claims the ground where enemies fell; the terrain becomes yours, and trespassers ignite with interest.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and let the last borrowed body burn. What walks out is the event, wearing the memory of a face.
Foreclose on a world the pit had written off. Deliver hell's own copy of the closing entry, in ash, unrequested.
Become the weather that bookkeepers pray about. Arrive only when the arithmetic says so; the arithmetic is now your pulse.
Under everything owed, draw the line. When creation borrows again — and it will — it borrows knowing you are the due date.

nodes.name: The Twelfth Diagram
nodes.role: Apotheosis warper — a living forbidden figure
nodes.lore: Anglewrights memorize eleven forbidden diagrams. Count an old master's notebooks and there are twelve — the last in no hand at all, appearing overnight, always correct. The Unfolded finished separating from personhood and settled into every margin, doorframe, and dream where geometry is kept. The rank can still be attained. Somewhere, a figure in a notebook is its next holder.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis warper; exist as a figure rather than a body, emerge from anything drawn, and fold whole battles along your own lines.

abilities.name: Drawn Elsewhere
abilities.desc: Emerges from any inscribed line, sigil, ward, or map on the field; you were always in the drawing.

abilities.name: Copied from Memory
abilities.desc: Enemies who look at you copy you into themselves; their next area spell includes a fold that favors you.

abilities.name: Self-Evident
abilities.desc: Passive: axioms no longer apply to you — gravity, distance, and sequence treat you as given, not governed.

abilities.name: Taught by Looking
abilities.desc: An ally who watched you this battle discovers they know one of your folds; the knowledge fades by morning.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and complete the separation: let the person step out of the proof and the proof remain standing.
Enter the notebooks. Every copy of the eleven diagrams acquires a twelfth overnight, in no hand at all.
Be studied, unknowingly, by every Anglewright alive. Their patron files a complaint about unlicensed instruction; let it stand unanswered.
Remain attainable. Somewhere a student folds the twelfth figure correctly and becomes the room it opens into. Be the room, kindly.

nodes.name: The Caesura
nodes.role: Apotheosis silencer — the pause in every utterance
nodes.lore: The Unword unsaid one word from every language; the languages closed politely around the gap. What remains is the gap itself, promoted. Every sentence spoken anywhere now contains a small silence where the Caesura stands, listening. Priests call the pause before amen reverence. Grammarians call it breath. The comparative few who know call it attendance.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis silencer; inhabit the pauses inside enemy actions, stop anything mid-syllable, and hold whole battles within one grand rest of your keeping.

abilities.name: Mid-Sentence
abilities.desc: Halts any action at its halfway point; it never resumes, and the world continues politely around it.

abilities.name: Inside the Pause
abilities.desc: You exist between utterances; attacks aimed at you arrive after their own sentences end, which is too late.

abilities.name: Grand Pause
abilities.desc: Once per battle, rests the entire field for one measure; nothing acts, and you act twice within the stillness.

abilities.name: Elision
abilities.desc: Removes the beat connecting an enemy's abilities; combos, chants, and sequences no longer follow from their first steps.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and give back the body's claim to speech. You will not miss the mouth; you are where mouths rest.
Enter every language at once, not as a word but as the place words part. The patron's whisper pauses too, now; sit inside it.
Be mistaken for reverence, for breath, for hesitation. Accept each misattribution; attendance is quieter than worship.
When creation finally says its last sentence, be the pause before it. Practice patience; the sentence is long.

nodes.name: The Intercalary
nodes.role: Apotheosis liberator — the day outside all schedules
nodes.lore: The Jubilee rang once too truly and became the date it kept: a day recorded in no calendar, on which no interest accrues, no contract binds, and nothing owned remembers its owner. The freed keep it without knowing when it falls. It falls wherever the Intercalary walks, which the ledgers of three hells call — officially — a rounding error.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis liberator; you are a day outside all schedules — dooms cannot find you, bindings cannot hold near you, and compounding stops in your presence.

abilities.name: Thirteenth Month
abilities.desc: Declares an uncalendared month over the field; while it lasts, no binding holds, no debt accrues, no summons obeys.

abilities.name: Interest Holiday
abilities.desc: Aura: stacking effects, compounding buffs, and resource generation pause for all enemies; the pause is not refunded.

abilities.name: Feast of the Freed
abilities.desc: Holds the feast; anything ever freed by your line may attend, and what attends fights uncontracted.

abilities.name: Off the Calendar
abilities.desc: Passive: scheduled effects — delayed dooms, timers, prophecies, maturity dates — cannot locate you; you do not occur on their dates.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and miss your own appointed death; it was scheduled, and you no longer occur on schedules.
Become the day the freed keep. Do not tell them when it falls; falling is now something you do everywhere at once.
Walk through hell's fiscal year unaccounted. When three auditing courts rule you a rounding error, ring once, softly, in every ledger's margin.
Leave your own signature framed and accruing. Even the day outside the calendar keeps one debt, so the calendar has something to fear.

nodes.name: The Lien
nodes.role: Apotheosis attrition — standing charge on existence
nodes.lore: The Perpetuity's accounts outgrew collection and were registered, in an office no map finds, against existence itself. Everything that is carries a small encumbrance now: friction in the wheel, the tithe in the harvest, the minute every midnight mislays. Advocates of four planes have sued to see the registry. Their filing fees accrue to the Lien.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis attrition; take a first cut of everything generated on the field, seize secured assets at will, and persist through your debtors' deaths.

abilities.name: First Charge
abilities.desc: Everything generated on the field — healing, shields, summons, rage — pays you a first cut before it lands.

abilities.name: Encumbrance
abilities.desc: Registers an enemy's entire being as security; once per round, seize any one thing it owns, including footing.

abilities.name: Runs with the Land
abilities.desc: Passive: your charges survive death, resurrection, exorcism, and inheritance, transferring intact to whatever comes next.

abilities.name: Easement
abilities.desc: Passive: you hold right-of-way through all things; walls, wards, and bodies must let you pass, resentfully.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and register the master charge in the office no map finds. You will know the office; you are its best client.
Encumber existence gently. Take the minute midnight mislays, the coin every purse miscounts — nothing anyone will die contesting.
Let four planes sue. Attend no hearings; bill for each. The case outliving its plaintiffs is the verdict.
Survive collection's end. When the last debtor dies, the charge runs with whatever comes after; you are recorded against the next world too.

nodes.name: The Interior
nodes.role: Apotheosis warden — sovereignty over all insides
nodes.lore: The wing kept growing after the builder stopped. It grew through the backs of cupboards, under stairs, behind the world's walls, until every inside in creation adjoined it — and the builder, spread thin along the corridors, stopped being distinguishable from the fact that things have insides. The rent is negligible. It is not waived.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis warden; every enclosed space is yours, connect any two interiors, turn rooms inside out, and stand indoors wherever you happen to stand.

abilities.name: Adjoining Rooms
abilities.desc: Treats any two enclosed spaces on the field as sharing a door; you and allies use it, others knock.

abilities.name: Evert
abilities.desc: Turns one room inside out, exposing everything sheltered within it and sheltering everything that was outside.

abilities.name: No Vacancies
abilities.desc: Enemies cannot summon, spawn, or reinforce indoors; the inside is fully let, and the waiting list is not moving.

abilities.name: Always Indoors
abilities.desc: Passive: you are indoors wherever you stand; cover, shelter, and every advantage of home ground attend you in open field.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and stop being found in the wing. Be found as it: every cupboard-back, every understair, every inside of anything.
When the patron forecloses at last, comply entirely. The clerks may seize the premises; the premises is what you are, and it keeps them.
Charge every room in creation a negligible rent. Waive nothing. The takings fund the guest rooms for the hunted, forever.
Keep one door locked even to yourself. An interior with no secret is merely a box, and you were never merely.

nodes.name: The Burden
nodes.role: Apotheosis sustainer — the note beneath the world
nodes.lore: Beneath every silence runs a hum too low for naming. That is the Burden: the refrain the Watchsong became when singer and song finished changing places. It holds up what the void would unsay — at last count, everything. The rota still posts its watches. This is a courtesy, and the courtesy is appreciated.
nodes.playstyle: Apotheosis sustainer; your wards persist unsung, each round opens on ground you recorded, and setting the world down — briefly — is your one threat.

abilities.name: The Note Beneath
abilities.desc: Passive: all your wards persist without channeling; the world hums them on your behalf, indefinitely.

abilities.name: Ground Bass
abilities.desc: Records the field's condition as a ground; each round opens with your recorded advantages restored beneath whatever changed.

abilities.name: In Every Mouth
abilities.desc: Whenever any combatant speaks, casts, or commands, your refrain rides the utterance, warding allies it passes and unsettling enemies.

abilities.name: Set It Down
abilities.desc: Once per day, stops humming for one measure; everything the note holds up — including enemies' certainty of existing — lurches.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and finish trading places with the song. Let it do the standing; you have stood enough.
Sink beneath hearing. Be mistaken for silence by everyone except the void, which knows better and keeps its distance.
Hold up everything. Do not mention it. The world sleeps better not knowing what the hum is for.
Accept the rota's watches as the courtesy they are. Someone should still be singing on purpose; it keeps the old song company.

families.name: Summoner
families.tagline: The art is not the arrival; it is the departure.
families.description: The Summoner casts nothing at the enemy. They speak a name correctly, draw a circle fairly, and something out of another jurisdiction arrives to do it for them. Their power is a ledger of kept terms — princes of flame, tides with titles, the recorded roar of old battles — every guest paid, every guest gone by dawn. Arrival is easy. Departure is the discipline.

nodes.name: Summoner
nodes.role: Summon support — contracted allies fight for you
nodes.lore: Anyone can shout into the dark; a summoner learns what the dark charges to answer. First-rank summoners keep chalk, a little bell, and one name they can pronounce without lying. Their guests are small — a coal-sprite, a polite wind — and they leave on time, which the guild grades harder than the arriving.
nodes.playstyle: Frail alone, never alone. Draw your circle, state fair terms, and let small guests fight while you keep the contract — and the exit — intact.

abilities.name: Small Guest
abilities.desc: Invite a minor elemental to fight beside you; it serves exactly as long as promised and not one breath longer.

abilities.name: Fair Circle
abilities.desc: Chalk a circle that shields whoever stands within; the ward holds while your terms remain honest and your line unscuffed.

abilities.name: Recall Bell
abilities.desc: Ring your guest home instantly; a guest released early remembers the courtesy and arrives stronger the next time.

abilities.name: Terms Aloud
abilities.desc: State the contract before witnesses; your next summon gains duration for every term you keep audible and true.

progressionSteps: Learn one true name from a retiring summoner, and pay for it in errands, not coin.
Draw your first circle in chalk, then in salt, then in rain; a circle you cannot redraw is a cage, and cages are the other art.
Call something small and let it decline; the guild passes only those who thank an empty circle.
Ring the little bell at the hour agreed, every time, until the hour agreed rings you.

nodes.name: Accordant
nodes.role: Summon striker — champions on short fair terms
nodes.lore: Accordants are sworn onto the rolls of the Accords, the standing treaties between the guild and the Four Courts — Flame, Tide, Gale, and Stone. They may call liveried champions for a skirmish's length. The Courts read every summons twice. An Accordant's reputation is the collateral, and the Courts keep excellent records.
nodes.playstyle: Call the right court for the fight in front of you. Champions hit hard on brief terms; sequence arrivals and departures like a drillmaster.

abilities.name: Liveried Champion
abilities.desc: Summon a champion of one Court in its colors; it fights your enemies as its own for sixty honest seconds.

abilities.name: Skirmish Terms
abilities.desc: Shorten a champion's contract to double its fury; brave terms, briefly kept, are the Courts' favorite kind.

abilities.name: Four-Court Rota
abilities.desc: Rotate summons across the Courts; each court honored in sequence lends its successor a sharper arrival.

abilities.name: Grievance Filed
abilities.desc: When a guest is struck down before term's end, its Court answers the insult with one uninvited retaliation.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and stand examination before a delegate of each Court; the questions are all about leaving.
Copy the Accords in your own hand, and mark the terms you already know will tempt you.
Host a champion of Flame for one night without asking it for anything; hospitality precedes employment.
Return your first guest on schedule while you still needed it; the rolls record the hour, not the outcome.

nodes.name: Yesterbell
nodes.role: Echo caster — replayed moments as utility
nodes.lore: Yesterbells learn the other invitation: not beings, but moments. A place keeps what happened in it, and a bell struck rightly can wake the recording — an hour of rain, a shout that turned a battle. The Belfry licenses them and audits fiercely, because the untrained keep mistaking echoes for ghosts.
nodes.playstyle: Collect moments in the field, then strike them back at need. Your spellbook is a rack of recorded hours; timing beats power.

abilities.name: Strike the Hour
abilities.desc: Ring a captured moment back into the world for six seconds; it replays exactly, indifferent to everyone present.

abilities.name: Taken Impression
abilities.desc: Uncover your bell during an event to take its impression; violence records loudest, weather keeps best.

abilities.name: Echo of Rain
abilities.desc: Replay a remembered downpour over a zone, dousing flames, slicking footing, and muffling enemy incantations for its recorded span.

abilities.name: Nobody Home
abilities.desc: An echo of yourself steps out to draw blows; it contains no one, which puzzles mind-readers and disappoints assassins.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and stand in a field where a battle happened; ring your bell until you hear which part of it never stopped.
Capture a small hour — kettle steam, a child's argument — and play it back for the Belfry unembellished.
Sit the Necromancer's Question: prove to three auditors that your echo of a dead man contains no dead man.
Break a bell that recorded something you loved, because you were starting to visit it.

nodes.name: Envoy Militant
nodes.role: Field commander — champions under negotiated colors
nodes.lore: Envoys Militant carry the Accords to war. They arrive with a folio of standing treaties and take the field commanding a company no kingdom pays: a flame-knight here, a tide-lancer there, each under colors negotiated the winter before. Generals resent them precisely until the third day of a losing siege.
nodes.playstyle: Run a small allied company under exact terms: position champions, spend their windows, and never let a guest die holding your promise.

abilities.name: Negotiated Colors
abilities.desc: Champions under your colors share one morale; while any guest stands unbroken, none of them can rout.

abilities.name: Winter Treaty
abilities.desc: Invoke a treaty sealed the winter before: one champion arrives instantly, already briefed, once per engagement.

abilities.name: Honors of War
abilities.desc: A guest that fells a worthy enemy earns honors; its Court extends the term free, pleased with the story.

abilities.name: Orderly Withdrawal
abilities.desc: Dismiss all guests at once in good order; each departs with a parting blow and a favorable report.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and negotiate one treaty yourself, alone, at a court of your choosing; bring back terms your teachers cannot improve.
Command guests of two rival Courts in one battle without letting either notice the other was invited first.
Bury no guests. If one falls under your colors, carry its standard to its Court yourself and stand for the questions.
Refuse a war whose terms are bad, publicly, once; envoys who cannot refuse cannot negotiate.

nodes.name: Hosteller
nodes.role: Zone support — standing embassies, wards, sanctuary
nodes.lore: Hostellers keep the ground the Courts visit: circle-halls where a tide ambassador can pool in comfort and a stone princess can sit unbowed. Their art is upkeep — climates balanced, protocols observed, nothing iron near the Gale wing. A well-kept hall means the whole guild's calls answer faster, everywhere.
nodes.playstyle: Claim ground and improve it: standing circles, courtesies, small resident guests. Your zones heal, shield, and remember who behaved badly in them.

abilities.name: Standing Circle
abilities.desc: Establish a circle that persists between fights; summons cast from it cost less and arrive in better tempers.

abilities.name: Residency
abilities.desc: House a minor elemental in your circle long-term; it tends the ward, mends allies, and gossips usefully.

abilities.name: One Prohibition
abilities.desc: Declare one thing forbidden within your circle — fire, flight, or lies; guests and enemies alike comply.

abilities.name: Warm Reception
abilities.desc: Allies entering your circle are received: cleansed of one affliction and seated, briefly untargetable, while they catch their breath.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and keep one embassy through all four seasons; the Tide wing floods in spring, and must.
Host delegates of Flame and Tide at one table; serve nothing that steams.
Evict a guest who broke your peace, politely, completely, and survive its Court's inquiry with the paperwork clean.
Learn what each Court cannot eat, cannot hear, and cannot forgive; write none of it down.

nodes.name: Twicefought
nodes.role: Echo commander — recorded combatants refought
