Painsetters call the practice gluttony dressed as mercy. Ague-Eaters, between chills, observe that mercy is the only thing worth being sick with.
nodes.playstyle: Pull every wound, ailment, and curse in the party into your own body, then outlast your collection. A bulwark whose armor is appetite.

abilities.name: Shared Cup
abilities.desc: Drink an ally's affliction out of them; it afflicts you at half strength, and you have had practice.

abilities.name: Fever-Hoard
abilities.desc: Each ailment you carry thickens your hide; at five carried ills, new hostile workings cannot find room in you.

abilities.name: Sickbed Authority
abilities.desc: Allies near you cannot worsen: bleeds, poisons, and curses pause while you are watching them.

abilities.name: Sweat It Out
abilities.desc: Purge everything you carry as one contagious exhalation; nearby enemies catch what you were kind enough to take.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and eat a village's whole fever-season, house by house, and be seen upright at the end of it.
Learn which of your carried ills keeps the others in order, and keep it.
Refuse the Painsetter's arithmetic to her face, politely; you will work beside her again.
Write your will early and update it annually; the order finds this steadies the hand.

nodes.name: Deasil
nodes.role: Party engine — blessings, regeneration, compounding luck
nodes.lore: Deasil is the old word for sunwise, and the Deasil Rounds dance with the day: their gyres knit flesh, sweeten wells, call rain in season, and lay luck on cradles by the dozen. They hold that many hands exist to fill, not empty. A shire with a Deasil Round wants for little, and denies having one with suspicious firmness.
nodes.playstyle: Turn the circle toward increase: layered blessings, compounding regeneration, luck bent generously. You win by making allies unkillable and harvests boring.

abilities.name: Sunwise Turn
abilities.desc: While your round turns with the sun, all healing received by allies in the circle increases for each ally dancing.

abilities.name: Cradle-Luck
abilities.desc: Lay luck on an ally at dawn; the day's first three killing blows against them miss, narrowly and deniably.

abilities.name: Sweetened Well
abilities.desc: Bless a point of ground; allies who drink, rest, or rally there shed one affliction and keep the taste.

abilities.name: Rain in Season
abilities.desc: Call the rain the season intended; allies mend beneath it, fires fail, and the enemy fights in mud of your scheduling.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and turn a starving parish green in one year using nothing traceable to miracle.
Dance the sun up on the year's longest day with your whole round, and feel it arrive early by a breath.
Bless three cradles of families who spat at you; the turning keeps no score.
Break one widdershins working gently, and invite its caster to dinner. Rivalry is not feud.

nodes.name: Toadstone
nodes.role: Pet bulwark — housed god, guarded ground
nodes.lore: Toadstones keep the great in the small: a drowned mill's genius in a toad, a forgotten harvest god in a one-eyed cat. The order holds that a familiar is a guest, never a tool — you do not ride what is older than your language. Their cottages are quiet, well-swept, and regarded by local gods as reputable lodging.
nodes.playstyle: Anchor ground around a housed power: your familiar barely moves, and barely needs to. Defense, awe, and the slow patience of something ancient.

abilities.name: Reputable Lodging
abilities.desc: Your familiar houses a far greater spirit; enemies who strike the small body answer to the guest.

abilities.name: Swept Ground
abilities.desc: Ground within the familiar's sight refuses violence done to sleepers, the wounded, and guests; breakers of the peace are struck lame.

abilities.name: Stone in the Head
abilities.desc: Draw the jewel from your familiar's brow once per day; it cures any one poison or reveals any one lie.

abilities.name: The Latch
abilities.desc: Lift the latch on the small body for one breath; whatever looks out ends the argument.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and offer lodging to something the last century evicted, and keep every promise made at the door.
Keep a god through its winter sulk without flattery and without fear. Firewood helps.
Turn away three kings who come to hire what lives in your cat.
Arrange your succession early; a house of this keeping must never stand empty at the keeper's death.

nodes.name: Blightsower
nodes.role: Area attrition — spreading agricultural ruin
nodes.lore: Blightsowers hold that a hex aimed is a hex wasted: proper cursing is husbandry, sown broadcast and reaped by whatever it finds. Murrain, rust, smut, and want follow their satchels the way gulls follow the plow. Overlookers call them indiscriminate. Blightsowers agree — so is winter, and nobody tries the frost at assize.
nodes.playstyle: Seed zones with slow agricultural ruin and let time do the killing. Wide, patient, amoral pressure; you own every field the fight lasts long enough to reach.

abilities.name: Broadcast Sowing
abilities.desc: Scatter curse-seed in a wide arc; every enemy it touches hosts a blight that ripens by the third minute.

abilities.name: Murrain
abilities.desc: Sicken the enemy's beasts, mounts, and summoned things first; cavalry becomes infantry, and infantry becomes tired.

abilities.name: Rust and Smut
abilities.desc: Crops, ropes, leather, and siegeworks in your fields decay at a season per second.

abilities.name: Blight Harvest
abilities.desc: Harvest your ripened blights; each afflicted enemy feeds the potency of your next working.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and sow a hunger, then watch it feed where it will; if you flinch, sow again until you do not.
Follow your own blight through a winter and bury whom it starves; the order requires attendance, not remorse.
Out-curse an Overlooker's measured doom with plain weather, and let the survivors judge which was kinder.
Keep one seed of every ruin you have raised, against the day a worse one is wanted.

nodes.name: Painsetter
nodes.role: Tactical healer — relocates harm at a price
nodes.lore: Painsetters cure by relocation: the fever goes into the pig, the madness into the sea, the wound into the man who gave it. Their law is conservation — nothing mends for free, and the cost must land where the setter says. Ague-Eaters call them heartless. Painsetters note, mildly, which of the two orders still makes house calls at ninety.
nodes.playstyle: Heal by redirecting harm into vessels you choose: beasts, stones, enemies, volunteers. Cold arithmetic with warm hands; the art is choosing where the cost lands.

abilities.name: Set Elsewhere
abilities.desc: Move any wound, ailment, or curse from an ally into a vessel within sight; vessels object at their own pace.

abilities.name: Into the Pig
abilities.desc: Standing livestock, summoned things, and pets can each carry two afflictions; the pig's opinion is noted and filed.

abilities.name: To Its Author
abilities.desc: Set a harm into whoever caused it; harms delivered to their authors arrive doubled and cannot be set again.

abilities.name: Stone-Sink
abilities.desc: Sink one affliction per day into bedrock, permanently; the field develops a reputation.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and empty a plague-house into a herd of swine, then drive the herd off the cliff yourself; delegation is for the squeamish.
Post your prices at the door and honor them in famine and in plague-year alike.
Set a dying stranger's wound into your own arm once, to know the weight; never make a habit of knowing it.
Answer the Ague-Eater's sermon with your census of the living. Bring numbers, not feelings.

nodes.name: Widdershins
nodes.role: Group dismantler — mass unraveling and stripping
nodes.lore: The Widdershins Rounds dance against the day. Their gyres unmake: knots untie, walls unmortar, oaths unswear, armies remember they are farmers. They hold that increase without undoing is only hoarding — some things must be turned backward out of the world for the year to breathe. Deasil shires sleep better for never asking who unwound the last tyrant.
nodes.playstyle: Turn the circle against things: strip enchantments, formations, and certainty in widening spirals. Little raw damage; everything the enemy counted on stops being countable.

abilities.name: Widdershins Turn
abilities.desc: While your round turns against the sun, every rotation strips one blessing, ward, or resolve from all enemies inside.

abilities.name: Unknotting
abilities.desc: Untie one bound thing: a summoned creature from its caster, a shield-wall from its discipline, a rider from her saddle.

abilities.name: Backward Dance
abilities.desc: Enemies caught in the gyre act in reverse order of their choosing; plans execute last step first.

abilities.name: Thirteen Turnings
abilities.desc: Complete thirteen rotations around a target; it is escorted out of the fight for thirteen seconds, unreachable and unmissed.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and unwind something the parish agrees needed unwinding; accept no payment and no thanks.
Dance a dead king's statue off its plinth with nine turnings, and leave the plinth for the pigeons.
Hold your own name steady while the round turns; those who forget themselves mid-gyre stay forgotten.
Break one deasil blessing gently, and accept the dinner invitation that follows. Rivalry is not feud.

nodes.name: Fetch-Candle
nodes.role: Dual-body skirmisher — self in two places
nodes.lore: Fetch-Candles keep no lodger; they keep themselves twice. The fetch is the witch's own spirit sent out in a small coat — a wren, a hare, a pale light over the marsh — while the body minds the kettle. Toadstones call it vanity. Fetch-Candles answer that at least they know their tenant by heart, and have never once been surprised by it.
nodes.playstyle: Operate two bodies with one attention: the small one scouts, hexes, and dies cheaply; the large one works safely from the hearth-line. Positioning, squared.

abilities.name: Small Coat
abilities.desc: Send your spirit out dressed as a wren, hare, or marsh-light; your body stands warded but vacant meanwhile.

abilities.name: Spare Coat
abilities.desc: If the small coat is destroyed, you snap home dazed but whole; the coat re-knits itself by moonrise.

abilities.name: Marsh-Light
abilities.desc: As the pale light, lead enemies a mile wrong; followers arrive tired, lost, and conveniently single-file.

abilities.name: One Witch Twice
abilities.desc: For ten seconds both bodies work at full strength; the headache arrives tomorrow, in whichever head you keep.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and spend a market-day as a wren; return before your kettle boils over, and know what the miller hides.
Be seen in two parishes at the same hour, and let the magistrates ruin each other's testimony.
Die once in the small coat, calmly; panic buried three promising Fetch-Candles last decade.
Choose which body ages. The order recommends deciding young.

nodes.name: The Third Look
nodes.role: Verdict caster — inevitable single-target dooms
nodes.lore: Folklore counts a witch's looks: the first notices, the second knows, the third concludes. The Third Look is that arithmetic made person. Histories dispute her — three duchies record her execution, each on a different date, and all three ruling houses are nonetheless extinct. Survivors of her attention agree on one detail: she seemed sorry.
nodes.playstyle: You do not cast at targets; you conclude them. Long observation arms instant verdicts, and one glance kills whatever has been thoroughly seen.

abilities.name: First Look
abilities.desc: Notice a target: their resistances, wrongs, and escape routes are revealed to you and dimmed for everyone else.

abilities.name: Second Look
abilities.desc: Know a target: their next three actions are disclosed to you before they choose them.

abilities.name: Third Look
abilities.desc: Conclude a target you have noticed and known; no ward answers, no armor applies. Twice a day, and never in haste.

abilities.name: Averted Gaze
abilities.desc: While your eyes are shut you cannot be targeted; the world returns the courtesy.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and survive your own execution three times, in three duchies, without once interrupting the proceedings.
Look once at a tyrant across a tournament field, and let the second look wait a year. Timing is the mercy.
Spare one deserving man because the case, on its third reading, held a doubt.
Train your successor by letting her watch you decline to look.

nodes.name: The Pesthouse
nodes.role: Immortal absorber — carries every affliction
nodes.lore: There is one Pesthouse a century, and the century argues about her. Cities that once walled up their sick now send them up her lane; the lane sends back cured strangers and no explanations. What she carries by now — the hoarded agues of a hundred parishes — has a mass the learned decline to calculate. She bakes on Thursdays.
nodes.playstyle: Absorb without limit and refuse to fall: everything hostile becomes something you carry, and everything you carry becomes wall. Attrition surrenders first.

abilities.name: Door Never Barred
abilities.desc: Any affliction on any ally you can name transfers to you at any distance; distance was never the hard part.

abilities.name: The Collection
abilities.desc: Each carried ill is armor and authority; hostile casters feel, briefly and vividly, what you are hosting, and reconsider.

abilities.name: Quarantine
abilities.desc: Draw one enemy into quarantine with you; nothing enters or leaves until one of you is cured of the other.

abilities.name: Thursday Bread
abilities.desc: Share loaves carrying a crumb of your immunity; allies who eat are proof against the next plague they meet.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and take in the epidemic no city would name, all of it, and answer your door the same week.
Count your collection every full moon; what you can still count, you can still carry.
Cure a Painsetter of something she could not set elsewhere; keep her secret and her friendship.
Outlive your physicians, your biographers, and the theory that you must be dead by now.

nodes.name: The Fat Year
nodes.role: Aura support — regional plenty, bent luck
nodes.lore: Some years everything comes through: the twins, the bridge, the barley. Almanacs mark them fat years and assume weather. Three shires each swear she wintered there, and none can prove it; all three have skipped their famines for a lifetime. Folk leave the first plate of every feast out, just in case. The Lean Year, asked about her, only smiles.
nodes.playstyle: Play the region, not the fight: standing luck, ambient mending, and hostile plans that quietly fail to come together. Your presence is the intervention.

abilities.name: First Plate
abilities.desc: Households that set you a portion fall under your table-peace; violence within them fails like damp powder.

abilities.name: The Bridge Holds
abilities.desc: Within your shire-wide aura, allied structures, mounts, and promises do not break at the worst moment; the worst moment is rescheduled.

abilities.name: Safe Delivery
abilities.desc: Once per day, an ally who should die instead arrives somewhere safe, confused, and hungry.

abilities.name: Just In Case
abilities.desc: Your workings leave no signature; divination about you returns only fair weather and a faint smell of bread.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and be a shire's whole difference for ten years without once being thanked to your face.
Turn a famine away at the border by arrangements nobody afterward can find in writing.
Let three shires argue over which of them you love best; a fat year is anyone's, which is the trick of it.
Refuse sainthood twice; the petitions die in committee both times, which was also your doing.

nodes.name: Ark of Small Gods
nodes.role: Pet pantheon — many small housed powers
nodes.lore: When rivers are dammed and groves are milled, their spirits walk, and the Ark is where they end up — nothing summoned, everything arrived on its own feet. Her household has been numbered at nine, thirteen, and one, depending on the theologian and how the cat felt about being counted. Nothing in her cottage is only what it looks like. Latterly, including the cottage.
nodes.playstyle: Convene a congregation of housed powers, each small body keeping an old dominion. You do not wield them — you chair them, and the meeting is armed.

abilities.name: Roll Call
abilities.desc: Call the household to order: every housed spirit performs one act of its old office — flood, harvest, thunder, silence.

abilities.name: Always Room
abilities.desc: House a defeated enemy spirit, summoned thing, or small god on the spot; it arrives furious and settles in by winter.

abilities.name: The Cat Abstains
abilities.desc: One household member always refuses your plan; its refusal reveals the plan's actual flaw.

abilities.name: Festival Right
abilities.desc: Host a guest's working at its ancient scale; it casts through you, once per its own feast-day.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and be, for one winter, the only roof between twelve homeless divinities and the reformers' bonfires.
Keep the peace at a table where flood sits across from drought; seat thunder below the salt and survive dinner.
Bury the god that chooses to end, properly, in a grave dug by hand; keeping includes the last part.
Decline godhead when the household offers to pool for it. Someone must keep the house.

nodes.name: The Lean Year
nodes.role: Field-scale attrition — scarcity as weapon
nodes.lore: Some years the harvest simply fails, and some years it is failed. Chronicles cannot settle whether the Lean Year was a woman or a weather: she is recorded burning in two centuries, marrying in a third, and gleaning, always gleaning, at the edge of every account. Where she walks in autumn, granaries audit themselves and come up short.
nodes.playstyle: Impose scarcity as a field condition: enemy mana, ammunition, morale, and reinforcements all arrive short. You do not defeat armies; you ration them into surrender.

abilities.name: Short Harvest
abilities.desc: All enemy resource generation on the field is cut by a share that grows each minute; the share is called hers.

abilities.name: Gleaner's Right
abilities.desc: Whatever enemies waste — missed arrows, overkill damage, spilled mana — you gather and spend as your own.

abilities.name: Seed Corn
abilities.desc: Force the choice: enemies who spend their last reserve draw your whole attention; those who hoard it starve slower.

abilities.name: Early Frost
abilities.desc: End one growing thing before its time — a summoned creature, a rally, a hope; it does not return this fight.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and starve a warlord's campaign to a treaty with no battle fought and no child's winter touched.
Glean behind every reaper in a bad shire for a season, and take only what was truly dropped.
Be burned in effigy at a harvest festival and attend it; judge the straw likeness on craft alone.
Keep one granary secretly full against the year after you; even the Lean Year sets seed aside.

nodes.name: The Henwife
nodes.role: Cost sovereign — sets the price of everything
nodes.lore: Every district remembers its henwife, who cured what mattered and charged what she liked. This one sets every price and is subject to none. Emperors have bid provinces for her hour; she has taken a hen, an apology, a promise kept before witnesses. Her ledger, recovered blank, hangs in a museum. Histories dispute whether anyone ever paid her in full.
nodes.playstyle: Reprice everything: wounds, deaths, miracles, mistakes. Nothing on your field resolves until its cost is met — by them, at the door, never on credit.

abilities.name: Stated at the Door
abilities.desc: Declare the cost of harming each ally — pain, mana, memory; enemies pay it on the spot or their blows refuse.

abilities.name: Taken in Kind
abilities.desc: Convert incoming harm into stated goods: the blow lands as lost speed, spilled mana, or confessed secrets instead of blood.

abilities.name: Never on Account
abilities.desc: Nothing may be taken from you now and paid for later; effects that would cost you in advance decline to occur.

abilities.name: Priceless
abilities.desc: Once per day, declare one ally beyond price; until dawn no effect, oath, or bargain can spend, trade, or claim them.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and hear the highest offer your century can make, and take a hen instead, and mean it.
Post your prices where kings queue, and charge beggar and king by the same unreadable scale.
Set the one price you will never collect, and outlive everyone who thinks that makes it negotiable.
Keep your ledger blank by settling everything at the door; a witch in credit is already half a warlock.

nodes.name: The Raveling
nodes.role: Mass disabler — unravels armies and workings
nodes.lore: Ravel means knit and unknit both; the old word never chose, and neither does she. Histories dispute what the Raveling undid — a dynasty, a doctrine, a war of forty years recalled now only as a rumor of mud. Where her round has danced, chroniclers find the chapter missing and the index unable to say what for.
nodes.playstyle: Unmake at the scale of institutions: armies, enchantments, allegiances, and sieges come apart in widening turns. Nothing dies; things stop being organized enough to fight.

abilities.name: Wide Gyre
abilities.desc: Your unraveling turns span a battlefield; each rotation strips armies of one layer — wards, orders, formation, cause.

abilities.name: Knit One
abilities.desc: The old word cuts both ways: reknit one unmade thing — a wall, a ward, a friendship — as easily as you unmade it.

abilities.name: Thread's End
abilities.desc: Find the one thread a great work hangs by; pull it, and the work has an hour to make its peace.

abilities.name: Recalled as Rumor
abilities.desc: Loosen a past event's grip on the present: oaths sworn upon it release, and grudges rooted in it forget their root.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and unwind a war so thoroughly that both armies march home certain they never mustered.
Dance alone one turning that used to need thirteen, and stop while your name still fits you.
Reknit one thing you were paid to leave unmade, because the old word never chose, and neither may you.
Leave every chronicle one thread; a past unraveled entirely is a kindness the living cannot afford.

nodes.name: The Fetch
nodes.role: True dual presence — two whole bodies
nodes.lore: At some point the question reversed: not whether her fetch had grown too real, but which of the two had been real first. The parish buried one of them in the year of the comet; attendance, the register notes, was two. Histories dispute which walked away. The Fetch, asked directly, answers that she gets that a lot.
nodes.playstyle: Two complete witches, one biography: both bodies cast, walk, and die independently, and neither is the spare. Lose one, and the other files the paperwork.

abilities.name: Both of Her
abilities.desc: Operate two full bodies at full strength anywhere on the field; their abilities cool down separately and alibi each other.

abilities.name: Which Was Buried
abilities.desc: When one body dies, prove it was the other one; the death is reassigned retroactively, with witnesses.

abilities.name: Seen Before Arriving
abilities.desc: Send your image a day ahead; wherever it was seen, you may later step in as though you had already been there.

abilities.name: Coat for a Friend
abilities.desc: Knit a dying ally a small coat; they persist as their own fetch until a body can be argued about later.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and attend the burial of one of you; carry the front left corner, and do not clarify which you are.
Live one year as the wren while the woman keeps house; the village must not notice the difference.
Meet yourself on the marsh road at dusk, which is fatal, and disagree about who dies.
Answer honestly, once, which of you was first. Practice the honest answer until it is true.

nodes.name: The Regard
nodes.role: Ambient executioner — judgment as standing law
nodes.lore: The Third Look concluded persons; something now concludes in general. The Regard is the standing fact of being seen: every fence-line wrong, every unwitnessed cruelty, is witnessed after all, and the files accumulate. Nations with clean consciences call it conscience. The others have, in recent centuries, taken heavily to curtains, which has not helped.
nodes.playstyle: You are ambient. Guilt, anywhere, is an address your verdicts already know; judgment arrives as weather does, unhurried and unanswerable. Play at the tempo of consequence.

abilities.name: Under Sky
abilities.desc: Every wrong done beneath the sky in your dominion is recorded to you at the moment of doing, with names.

abilities.name: The Curtains Fail
abilities.desc: No ward, roof, lie, or distance obstructs your seeing; the attempt itself is entered as evidence.

abilities.name: Season of Consequence
abilities.desc: Ripen every recorded wrong in a region at once; each doer meets their accumulated case as a single event.

abilities.name: Stay of Doom
abilities.desc: Withhold a deserved conclusion indefinitely; the deferral is felt, and entire dynasties have reformed inside it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and stop looking at anything in particular; particularity was the last limit.
Be cited in law codes you never wrote — as under the Regard, the clerks put it — and let the citation do the policing.
Answer no petitions; the knowledge that you saw is the entire service.
When two empires wrong each other in secret, be the reason neither believes it got away. Peace by mutual certainty.

nodes.name: The Remission
nodes.role: Absolute sustain — concludes afflictions everywhere
nodes.lore: Plagues end. Physicians take credit, priests take tithes, and the fever, asked where it went, would answer: to her. The Remission is the office sickness retires into — the standing mercy by which afflictions, having raged, abate. The Pesthouse carried what she took; the Remission is where taking goes. Fevers break at her name, embarrassed.
nodes.playstyle: End categories of harm rather than instances: not this wound healed but this wound concluded, here, for everyone. Support at the scale of a century's health.

abilities.name: General Abatement
abilities.desc: Declare one affliction concluded field-wide; every instance on every ally ends, and new castings of it fail politely.

abilities.name: The Corner Turned
abilities.desc: Any ally at death's threshold instead turns the corner; the turn is audible, like weather clearing.

abilities.name: Retired Plague
abilities.desc: Take a named disease out of the world into your keeping; it is henceforth folklore, and folklore is yours.

abilities.name: No Relapse
abilities.desc: Ground you bless mends: all healing there compounds daily, and nothing may relapse inside your fences.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and end a plague by accepting its retirement; grant the pension personally.
Inherit the Pesthouse's whole collection and file it where nothing relapses — in the office, not the woman.
Let physicians publish your work under their own names for a hundred years; correct only the dosages.
Remain the reason fevers break at three in the morning; accept no shrine larger than a kept garden.

nodes.name: The Ingathering
nodes.role: Cosmic support — brings all things home
nodes.lore: Harvests come home; so, eventually, does everything else. The Ingathering is the office by which strays return: lost ships, last sheaves, prodigal sons, seed thought extinct since the burning years. The Deasil Rounds danced increase; she is where increase was always headed. Autumn is her paperwork. The feast at the end of it sets, in every land at once, one extra place.
nodes.playstyle: Bring things home as a combat verb: allies to safety, strength to the weary, the lost to the found. Attrition cannot beat a harvest that recovers everything.

abilities.name: Called Home
abilities.desc: Recall any ally from anywhere — battle, capture, error — to your table, mended and fed, once each per day.

abilities.name: Last Sheaf
abilities.desc: Nothing allied is left behind; the fallen, the dropped, and the routed are gathered standing at your side by dusk.

abilities.name: Laid for One More
abilities.desc: Any stranger who joins your side mid-fight arrives blessed; there was always a place set for them.

abilities.name: Harvest Home
abilities.desc: Once per season, everything ever taken from those under your roof — years, strength, hope — comes home ripened.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and become the direction home lies in; compasses will not show it, but feet know.
Bring in a harvest from fields that burned in spring; where you glean, the year relents.
Set the feast at which every empty chair is filled by whoever it was kept empty for.
When the last stray of an age comes up the lane, be on the step, with the lamp, unsurprised.

nodes.name: The Household
nodes.role: Spirit host — houses the world's powers
nodes.lore: The world keeps a Household for powers with nowhere to be: retired gods, dammed rivers, faiths down to their last believer. It is not a place; it is a keeping, and someone holds the keys. Theology files the Household under metaphor. The metaphor's chimney smokes. Applicants knock at the small door, which is any door, after dark.
nodes.playstyle: Host at world scale: every power you house is a room, and any room can be opened onto any battlefield. You never fight alone; you fight as a full house.

abilities.name: Any Door After Dark
abilities.desc: Enter or leave through any door in the world after dusk; guests and allies may be conducted through with you.

abilities.name: Open House
abilities.desc: Throw one housed power's room open around you — the drowned mill's flood, the harvest god's noon — for a minute.

abilities.name: Beneath This Roof
abilities.desc: Declare ground your roof's shadow; violence there requires your leave, and your leave has conditions.

abilities.name: Re-Keyed
abilities.desc: When you die, the Household simply re-keys; you resume at the hearth by the next dark of the month, keys still in your apron.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and accept the keys from the Ark's estate; the will names no heir, only whoever kept the house.
House something no roof has ever agreed to hold, and lose no sleep you had not already scheduled to lose.
Evict exactly one guest in your whole tenure, for cause, in winter; be right, and never say what it did.
Keep the chimney smoking through the death of the metaphor; theology will re-file you eventually. Be home when it does.

nodes.name: The Pruning
nodes.role: World gardener — cuts powers down to size
nodes.lore: Everything grows rank if nothing cuts it back: orchards, dynasties, pantheons. The Pruning is the world's standing horticulture — the office by which what has overgrown its portion is cut to live, and what will not be cut is cut anyway. Farmers bless her rotation. Empires appeal it. The appeals are heard in the order received, in pruning season.
nodes.playstyle: Impose limits as an absolute: powers, armies, and miracles you designate are cut back to a size you choose. You do not break enemies; you trim them, renewably.

abilities.name: Cut Back
abilities.desc: Prune one enemy power at its source — a god's favor, a legion's discipline, a mage's talent; it regrows smaller.

abilities.name: Fallow Strip
abilities.desc: Divide the field into strips and rest one at a time; nothing in a resting strip may act, suffer, or scheme.

abilities.name: Exhausted Soil
abilities.desc: Ground that has hosted too much war refuses further armies; they sink to the knee in its refusal.

abilities.name: Seventh Year
abilities.desc: Every seventh working you witness is canceled for rest, including — the office is strict — your own.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and cut back a war that had run three generations; size the wound so the fourth is born bored of it.
Prune a god over its objections and wake it kinder; take no credit for the improvement.
Let your own garden lie unworked one year in seven, publicly; a law that exempts the lawgiver is a hex.
When the world itself grows thin, schedule its rest against every empire's appeal. Hear the appeals fully. Grant none.

nodes.name: The Crossroads
nodes.role: Bargain sovereign — every exchange passes through her
nodes.lore: Bargains want a witness; forks want a resident. The Crossroads is both: every bargain struck where roads meet is struck in her hearing, and holds. Witches were buried at crossroads to confuse their walking; it worked backward — now every crossroads is her, and the traffic in promises pays its respects. She carries no one anywhere; she only witnesses what they trade to go.
nodes.playstyle: Preside over exchange itself: every trade, oath, and bargain on the field routes through you, and you may amend the terms at the fork.

abilities.name: Struck in Your Hearing
abilities.desc: Every bargain made within your dominion is witnessed by you and binds only as deeply as you countersign.

abilities.name: Fork the Road
abilities.desc: Place a crossroads under an enemy mid-stride; they must choose a road, and both were built by you.

abilities.name: Amended at the Fork
abilities.desc: Amend any active bargain, blessing, or compact that crosses your ground; warlock compacts arrive particularly amendable.

abilities.name: Buried Standing
abilities.desc: Having been buried at your own office, death is a road like the others; take it in both directions, once per season.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be buried at the crossroads with full ceremony; be waiting at the next fork the mourners reach.
Witness the oldest bargain still running and decline to say between whom; some traffic predates the roads.
Untangle the junction where seven kingdoms' roads and treaties knot, and charge each kingdom one hen.
Keep faith with the buried: any witch interred at any fork wakes rested in your jurisdiction, and owes nothing for it.

nodes.name: The Unwinding
nodes.role: Entropy sovereign — gentle, total disassembly
nodes.lore: What is wound must someday unwind — springs, oaths, dynasties, the year itself. The Unwinding is that law with a name on it: the standing office by which the world is taken apart gently enough to survive it. The Raveling unwound kingdoms; the Unwinding is why unwinding works at all. Nothing she attends comes apart screaming. That is the whole mercy, and it suffices.
nodes.playstyle: Operate as entropy with manners: designate what comes apart, in what order, and how gently. You never destroy; you conclude assemblies, and everything is an assembly.

abilities.name: Gently Apart
abilities.desc: Disassemble any construct, formation, spell, or siege into harmless parts; the parts remember being whole, fondly.

abilities.name: Wound Down
abilities.desc: Slow one enemy's mainspring: each action costs them more than the last, until stillness is the cheapest choice left.

abilities.name: Order of Parting
abilities.desc: Choose the sequence in which an enemy's powers, weapons, and resolve depart; they watch the schedule keep itself.

abilities.name: Comes Apart Kindly
abilities.desc: Whatever you unmake ends without pain, terror, or ghosts; the mercy is famous, and famously demoralizing.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and unwind one age of the world so gently its people call it history instead of catastrophe.
Take apart a war-engine of ten thousand parts and lay them out in a meadow in the order of their making.
When something beloved must end, attend it personally; the office exists so that endings are kept kind.
Remember alone what the world was spared; carry the list without sharing it, even deasil, even at dinner.

nodes.name: The Glimpse
nodes.role: Omnipresent haunt — seen everywhere, held nowhere
nodes.lore: Everyone has seen her: the figure at the edge of the eye, the reflection half a step behind, the shape at the window of an empty house. The Fetch was two; the Glimpse is distributed. She is the world's spare presence — kept, like all good myths, just out of focus. Turning to look is the one prayer she always answers, with absence.
nodes.playstyle: Exist peripherally everywhere at once: strike from the corner of the eye, vanish under direct attention. Untargetable by anything that must look at what it kills.

abilities.name: Corner of the Eye
abilities.desc: Act from anyone's peripheral vision anywhere; direct observation ends your presence there and begins it somewhere less convenient.

abilities.name: Half-Step Behind
abilities.desc: Attach to an enemy's reflection; everything they do arrives half a step late, and the lateness accumulates.

abilities.name: The Window Figure
abilities.desc: Be seen, once, deliberately, in full; the seer must sit down for a while. Usable sparingly. Remembered always.

abilities.name: Answered With Absence
abilities.desc: When targeted, be elsewhere retroactively; the attack finds the place you are famous for having just left.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and let go of the second body, then the first; the glimpse of you is body enough now.
Be seen on the same dusk by a sailor, a queen, and a child in a mirror, and be all three sightings.
Visit every window of every empty house once a generation; the houses stay empty out of respect.
Never be looked at directly again; grant the world instead the certainty that you could be, which keeps it kind.

families.name: Dreamwalker
families.tagline: Sleep is a country, and someone must walk its roads.
families.description: Nightly the world crosses, unknowing, into the one country every border shares. The Dreamwalker goes on purpose. Sleep is a place; places have roads; roads want walking. Some learn the soft country's geography and carry words no checkpoint can stop. Others keep its fauna, breaking and pasturing nightmares as drier lands keep hawks and herds. The dreaming is no omen, no afterlife — a country, and the Dreamwalker its honest traffic.

nodes.name: Dreamwalker
nodes.role: Skirmisher-scout — lulls foes, slips between
nodes.lore: Some children never learn the difference between falling asleep and leaving. Most have it taught out of them. The rest wake with road-dust on their feet, are found sooner or later by the walking trade, and learn the first law of the soft country: it is a place, you are in it, and places can be crossed.
nodes.playstyle: Fight light and half-elsewhere; drowse the dangerous, slip through nearby sleep to reposition, and remember your sleeping body is the only door an enemy needs.

abilities.name: Practiced Drowse
abilities.desc: Drop into true sleep in three breaths, anywhere, and rise from it without grogginess or delay.

abilities.name: Pinch of Sand
abilities.desc: Flick dream-sand at a foe's eyes; their next action drags as sleep tugs the lids.

abilities.name: The Near Hem
abilities.desc: Sense every sleeper within a bowshot and the rough weather of what they dream.

abilities.name: Step Through Sleep
abilities.desc: Where someone nearby sleeps, slip through their dream and out again, emerging several paces from where you stood.

progressionSteps: Fall asleep somewhere wrong — a battlefield, a birthday, a border — and wake on a road that was not there yesterday.
Walk the road instead of waking, and answer the stranger at the first crossing when they ask whose dream this is: no one's.
Learn to sleep in rain, in grief, and at noon, until the door opens the moment you knock.
Deliver one small true word to a sleeping friend and hear them repeat it at breakfast, wondering.

nodes.name: Sleepfarer
nodes.role: Infiltrator-scout — long travel, soft entry
nodes.lore: The trade rates a Sleepfarer by what they can cross: a river, a siege line, a quarantine. They travel the shallows of a thousand strangers' sleep, polite as any guest, and step out the far side of geography with the news still warm. Waking checkpoints have begun, uselessly, to inspect pillows.
nodes.playstyle: Go where walls say you cannot: enter through nearby sleep, scout the soft country's shallows, and come back carrying routes, weaknesses, and unbought truth.

abilities.name: Borrowed Bed
abilities.desc: Enter the dream of any sleeper you can see or touch, without waking or harming them.

abilities.name: Softcountry Stride
abilities.desc: Cross the shallows at the pace of a night's rest; leagues of waking country pass in an hour of walking.

abilities.name: Thin Hour
abilities.desc: Find the hour and place where waking and sleep sit closest, easing your whole party briefly across.

abilities.name: Guest Manners
abilities.desc: Dreams do not turn on you; their weather, monsters, and doors treat you as furniture until you act.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and cross your first sealed border asleep, carrying a word the checkpoint would have hanged you for.
Sleep in the same inn as a stranger and walk their dream from hearth to hedge without once being noticed.
Map the shallows of a village in one night: who dreams of the sea, who of fire, who of the door upstairs.
Return from the soft country with mud on your boots that no waking road could have put there.

nodes.name: Maregroom
nodes.role: Beast handler — one leashed terror, harried foes
nodes.lore: Every district has bad nights, and someone must muck them out. Maregrooms are called for the child who screams at moonrise and the garrison that has stopped sleeping; they net the mare at the bedside, halter it, and lead it away calm. The sleeper wakes lighter. What the groom leads home is now the groom's problem.
nodes.playstyle: Manage a stabled terror like a working animal; loose it to harry and horrify, recall it before it forgets whose leash it wears.

abilities.name: Bedside Net
abilities.desc: Net a feeding nightmare out of a sleeper's dream; the sleeper wakes rested and unaware.

abilities.name: Halter of Sighs
abilities.desc: Bind a caught terror with woven breath; it cannot flee, feed, or turn on you while haltered.

abilities.name: Loose the Mare
abilities.desc: Slip your terror at a foe; it rides them with dread, souring aim, nerve, and footing.

abilities.name: Stable Temper
abilities.desc: Read a terror's mood at a glance and settle it; your beasts recover fast and spook never.

progressionSteps: Reach level 10 and clear a haunted nursery alone, leading the mare out by dawn without waking the child.
Keep your first terror stabled a full season: fed little, worked often, and never once named.
Stand stable-watch through a screaming winter and learn which fears bite because they are cruel and which because they are cold.
Lose a mare you had grown fond of, and learn what the halter is for.

nodes.name: Nightpost
nodes.role: Mobile skirmisher — courier speed, strike and relocate
nodes.lore: Couriers of the walking trade, sworn to the delivery and to nothing else. A Nightpost carries what cannot cross awake — treaties, confessions, a warning running ahead of an army — through the sleep of whoever lies between. Paid on arrival, never on departure. Kings distrust them precisely as much as kings use them, which is constantly.
nodes.playstyle: Move first and often; dart through sleeping ground to flank, deliver each blow like a sealed letter, and be three dreams away before the reply.

abilities.name: Sealed Word
abilities.desc: Carry a message none can read, coax, or cut out of you; it exists only at its address.

abilities.name: Relay of Beds
abilities.desc: Chain crossings between nearby sleepers to cross a battlefield in heartbeats, arriving behind whoever felt safest.

abilities.name: Outrun the Rider
abilities.desc: Once per night, declare a destination; nothing traveling by waking roads arrives there before you.

abilities.name: Cold Delivery
abilities.desc: Your first strike against an unaware foe lands with a whole journey's momentum behind it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and run the Long Round: nine cities, nine nights, nine words delivered, none read.
Outpace a purge; carry the proscription list to the names on it and arrive before the knives do.
Refuse your first fortune for the opening of one seal, and report the offer to nobody.
Wear out three pairs of boots on roads that do not exist.

nodes.name: Legate of the Shallows
nodes.role: Support controller — parley fields, pacification
nodes.lore: Diplomacy's quiet way around itself. A Legate arranges meetings that cannot exist: enemies asleep in their own camps, seated at one table in a borrowed dream. The Legate keeps the venue and the protocol — who may speak, what may follow the guests out — and bills both sides, which is traditional.
nodes.playstyle: Impose parley on chaos; lull hostilities, draw combatants briefly into the shallows to talk or falter, and reposition friend and foe like place-settings.

abilities.name: Borrowed Table
abilities.desc: Pull willing or sleeping minds into a shared shallow dream where you set the room and the rules.

abilities.name: The Floor Is Given
abilities.desc: Name one speaker in the shallows; all others find tongue and limbs heavy while they interrupt.

abilities.name: Nothing Follows You Out
abilities.desc: Wounds, oaths, and workings taken inside your parley stay inside it unless you permit otherwise.

abilities.name: Seating Plan
abilities.desc: Rearrange everyone within your shallows; the meeting adjourns with each guest standing where you preferred them.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and host your first impossible meeting: two men who have each paid for the other's funeral, sharing salt.
Raise a meeting-house from a stranger's borrowed comfort, with chairs enough for every grudge invited.
Hold protocol when a guest draws steel in your shallows, and let what happens to him be instructive.
Be paid by both sides, thanked by neither, and mentioned in no account of the peace.

nodes.name: Fewterer
nodes.role: Beastmaster striker — leashed terrors slipped at quarry
nodes.lore: Grooms turned hunters. A Fewterer keeps a brace of broken terrors leashed at the wrist and slips them at whatever the contract names: deserters, rogue mares, the occasional waking monster that has never yet been afraid. The pay is good, the kennel-work constant, and the leash-hand always cold.
nodes.playstyle: Hunt in tandem; slip your terrors to run down and unman the quarry, then close in yourself while its nerve is elsewhere.

abilities.name: Slipped Brace
abilities.desc: Loose two leashed terrors at one quarry; they harry it from either side of sleep.

abilities.name: Cold Leash
abilities.desc: Your terrors return to heel from any distance, dragging a mouthful of the quarry's courage with them.

abilities.name: Hounded Sleepless
abilities.desc: Quarry your terrors have touched cannot hide, rest, or profit from sleep until you call off the hunt.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and break your first wild-caught terror to the leash without dulling its teeth.
Course a quarry across three nights' dreaming and take it at dawn, awake and too tired to be afraid.
Learn the kennel-law: feed them before yourself, walk them before you sleep, and never let them taste you.

nodes.name: Mareherd
nodes.role: Flock controller — area dread, herd management
nodes.lore: Where a groom keeps one beast, a Mareherd runs the valley's whole flock of fears: folding the small ones at dusk, thinning the biters, driving the herd off a town that cannot stand another bad week. Landholders pay them the way they pay against weather — grudgingly, and every year.
nodes.playstyle: Fight with the flock; blanket ground in grazing dread, cut one terror out to bite, and herd enemies toward where their courage is thinnest.

abilities.name: Dusk Folding
abilities.desc: Gather every minor fear on the field into your fold; enemies lose their dreads, and you keep them.

abilities.name: Cut One Out
abilities.desc: Send a chosen terror from the flock at a single foe; it knows exactly which fear fits.

abilities.name: Drive the Herd
abilities.desc: Stampede the flock across an area; all caught in it are hazed, scattered, and moved your way.

abilities.name: Shepherd's Count
abilities.desc: Know the number, size, and appetite of every fear within a night's walk.

progressionSteps: Reach level 25 and take a valley's contract: one year, every bedroom, no deaths by dreaming.
Cull your first man-eater in front of the flock, so the flock understands the terms of employment.
Drive a hundred small fears across a river of sleep without losing one to the deeps.
Winter the flock on your own sleep when the grazing runs out, and wake each morning having paid for it.

nodes.name: Causewright
nodes.role: Battlefield engineer — lanes, footing, mass mobility
nodes.lore: Half of what the Post split over, two centuries back. Causewrights hold that even a soft country owes its travelers footing, and pave accordingly: staked fords, raised causeways, waystones that keep their place from dream to dream. Any trained sleeper can walk a made road. Deepstrays call this farming. Causewrights note whose mail arrives.
nodes.playstyle: Lay road under the fight; allies on your ground move faster, stand surer, and withdraw in good order down ways no enemy can find.

abilities.name: Waystone
abilities.desc: Plant a stone that exists on both sides of sleep; allies can always find, and rally at, your stones.

abilities.name: Raised Causeway
abilities.desc: Firm ground unrolls ahead of your party — over mire, rubble, or panic — granting speed and certain footing.

abilities.name: Camber and Drain
abilities.desc: Hostile ground-effects run off your road like rainwater; your lanes cannot be cursed, mired, or frightened.

abilities.name: The Road Holds
abilities.desc: Once per battle, an ally's forced movement, fall, or rout simply does not happen while they stand on your road.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and drive a causeway through the deeps that a frightened stranger could cross alone; then watch one do it.
Set a waystone in the dream of a city that hates your guild, and maintain it for a year of nights.
Survey the shallows of a coming war: where the routs will run, where the widows will walk. Pave accordingly.
Accept a Deepstray's apology when your road saves their delivery, without smiling.

nodes.name: Chatelain of the Hem
nodes.role: Sanctuary warder — inviolable ground, guest-law
nodes.lore: Keepers of the great peace-houses standing just past the hem of sleep. A Chatelain's law is short: under this roof, nothing wounds, nothing binds, nothing follows you home. Break it and you are put out — not from the house, from the dreaming. Snarehosts find the whole arrangement naive. Chatelains keep a room ready for them.
nodes.playstyle: Hold an inviolable house around your allies; harm must knock, guests answer to the salt, and those who force the door answer to the hem.

abilities.name: Roof of the Hem
abilities.desc: Raise the house around your allies; attacks, curses, and terrors must knock, and you keep the door.

abilities.name: Guest-Salt
abilities.desc: Any who accept your salt cannot raise a hand against your other guests while the house stands.

abilities.name: Put Out
abilities.desc: Eject one offender from the dreaming; they wake alone, exhausted, and barred from sleep's country for days.

abilities.name: The Room Ready
abilities.desc: Once per battle, an ally struck down is instead found abed in your house, stable and sleeping.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and hold the door of a peace-house while a war tries to come in; keep it a war outside.
Give the room ready to your worst enemy on a bad night, and charge the usual rate.
Put out a king. Readmit him when he apologizes to the scullery.
Learn every hinge, joist, and kindness of your house until it knows you asleep or waking.

nodes.name: Cruelhood
nodes.role: Beast tyrant — one apex terror, absolute command
nodes.lore: The elder doctrine of the mews: a terror is tackle, and tackle gets no name. Cruelhoods break the great fears to hood and jess by being the worst thing in any room. Asked whether a broken terror loves them, they answer that the leash does not care. The name is no accusation; it is the tool on their belt.
nodes.playstyle: Field one apex terror as a living siege engine; it strikes, screens, and horrifies on command, and its obedience is never in question.

abilities.name: The Hood Comes Off
abilities.desc: Unhood your apex terror at a chosen foe; it attacks with perfect focus and cannot be diverted.

abilities.name: Jess-Law
abilities.desc: Your terror cannot be charmed, turned, stolen, or frightened; its will is not in the room.

abilities.name: Worst Thing in the Room
abilities.desc: Enemy beasts and terrors that watch you correct your own lose their nerve; yours has none left to lose.

abilities.name: Broken to the Fist
abilities.desc: Recall your terror from any distance or danger instantly; whatever held it keeps nothing.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and break a named fear — one with a district to its reputation — without help, sleep, or sentiment.
Hood the thing that emptied Marrowdown in a single night, and walk it to heel through the survivors' camp.
Refuse to name it. Refuse twice. The second refusal is the one the order watches for.

nodes.name: Drownsman
nodes.role: Terror-executioner — anti-fear, anti-beast purges
nodes.lore: The cull doctrine, plainly practiced. Drownsmen hold that the only safe night is an empty one: they run drowning-drives through infested sleep, thin the spring litters, and keep honest tallies of what a county's peace cost. Graziers call them famine-makers. Drownsmen answer that nobody they serve has ever been eaten.
nodes.playstyle: Purge the field; every fear, terror, and conjured horror is quarry, and each one destroyed leaves the night around you harder to haunt.

abilities.name: The Drowning Fold
abilities.desc: Drag a nightmare or summoned horror under the surface of sleep; it does not come back up.

abilities.name: Vermin Tally
abilities.desc: Mark every fear-born and conjured thing on the field; your strikes against marked quarry cut double.

abilities.name: Empty Night
abilities.desc: Clear all dread, terror, and panic from an area; for a while, nothing frightening can enter it.

abilities.name: Cold Arithmetic
abilities.desc: Each quarry destroyed steadies you; fear finds no purchase on a Drownsman in the middle of a count.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and empty a market town's nights inside one month, leaving a tally the mayor can read.
Drown a litter you had the skill to break and sell, because the doctrine is not about you.
Walk a Grazier's pasture at lambing with your hands in your pockets; the feud has rules.

nodes.name: Deepstray
nodes.role: Evasive striker — trackless, arrives from nowhere
nodes.lore: The other half of the split. Deepstrays hold that a road through a living country is a leash on it: they deliver by drifting, never the same way twice, and unpick abandoned causeways like snares. Causewrights call them vagrants. Deepstrays reply that the mail arrives anyway, and that the country, notably, still lets them through.
nodes.playstyle: Arrive by being lost correctly; no route, no schedule, no tracks — strike from angles the country invents for you, and unravel the ways behind you.

abilities.name: Never Twice
abilities.desc: No path you take exists afterward; pursuit finds meadow, wall, or water where your road was.

abilities.name: Drifting Delivery
abilities.desc: Cross any distance in the dreaming by surrendering your heading; you arrive when the country decides, which is early.

abilities.name: Unpicked Road
abilities.desc: Unravel a stretch of made road or known ground; those standing on it are strewn where it wasn't.

abilities.name: Snare-Wise
abilities.desc: You cannot be ambushed along a way; anything waiting finds you already behind it.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and deliver to a city the roads have lost, by losing yourself better than the roads did.
Unpick a dead causeway before something learns to wait beside it, and leave the waystones to the moss.
Cross the deeps without a heading and let the country hand you to your destination like a parcel.

nodes.name: Snarehost
nodes.role: Zone manipulator — hospitality as ambush
nodes.lore: The Legates' other answer. Snarehosts observe that a dream is always somebody's house and neutrality a curtain somebody hung, so they hang it themselves: venues that negotiate, doors that favor, chairs that soften resolve, weather with a position on the agenda. Every Chatelain house, they note, has a best chair. Someone decides who sits in it.
nodes.playstyle: Prepare the ground like a dinner; enemies arrive into seating, sightlines, and moods you chose, and the trap is indistinguishable from courtesy.

abilities.name: Prepared Venue
abilities.desc: Battles you begin happen in a room you dressed; you place cover, exits, and mood before anything is drawn.

abilities.name: The Best Chair
abilities.desc: One enemy is seated — comfortable, flattered, and unable to act while anyone is speaking to them.

abilities.name: Weather With a Position
abilities.desc: The venue's weather takes your side; rain, gloom, and warmth apply themselves to your agenda.

abilities.name: Doors That Favor
abilities.desc: Exits open where you prefer; an enemy's retreat delivers them to the smaller room you had in mind.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and host a summit where the terrain does the negotiating and your client never speaks.
Seat a delegation of seven so that their alliance dissolves by dessert, blamelessly.
Attend a Chatelain's peace-house as a courteous guest, break no law, and leave the doubt behind you like a coat.

nodes.name: Quarrysworn
nodes.role: Pack skirmisher — willing terrors, shared hunt
nodes.lore: The mews' heresy. A Quarrysworn takes no net and no hood: they walk into the deeps, let a terror hunt them, and survive it until the hunt curdles into something older, and it follows them out. Their beasts fly free and come back. Cruelhoods say a loved terror is spoiled. Quarrysworn answer that fear knows how to slip a jess.
nodes.playstyle: Run with the pack; your terrors fight unleashed and choose their moments, and they grow stronger for every scar you take in front of them.

abilities.name: Survived You
abilities.desc: Terrors that have hunted you obey no one else and cannot be turned against you by any craft.

abilities.name: Free Cast
abilities.desc: Your beasts range unleashed and strike at their own judgment; their instincts outrank your orders, correctly.

abilities.name: Taste Given Freely
abilities.desc: Feed a terror your own fear before battle; when you falter, it returns the strength doubled.

abilities.name: The Pack Answers
abilities.desc: When you fall below half your strength, the nearest terror you have earned arrives, invited or not.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and go into the deeps unarmed; be hunted by something with a name, and come out walking.
Sleep three nights in its territory afterward, uneaten. On the fourth it will lie down within reach. Do not touch it yet.
Take a wound meant for it, in front of it. This cannot be staged; it will know.
Never call it. The day it comes anyway, you are Quarrysworn.

nodes.name: Grazier of the Small Hours
nodes.role: Attrition controller — dosed dread, managed pasture
nodes.lore: The feeding doctrine. A Grazier runs fear on rotation, dosing towns with small survivable nightmares the way fields are dosed with ash — because fear unfed does not die. It fasts, and its appetite comes back famine-sized. Drownsmen call this farming wolves. Graziers point to the quiet counties, and wait.
nodes.playstyle: Bleed the enemy by installment; graze small dreads across their line, harvest the panic they compound into, and starve nothing you may need later.

abilities.name: Measured Dose
abilities.desc: Afflict a foe with a small survivable dread each round; the doses compound quietly until the whole herd arrives at once.

abilities.name: Rotation
abilities.desc: Move your grazing dreads between foes at will; fresh pasture makes them fatter, faster.

abilities.name: Fear Unfed
abilities.desc: An enemy who resists your dreads is saving them up; when one finally lands, it lands famine-sized.

abilities.name: Small Hours
abilities.desc: Your flock feeds strongest after midnight; night battles begin with your herds already fat.

progressionSteps: Reach level 40 and take a county on rotation: every town dreams badly once a season, mildly, on schedule.
Explain the schedule to a mayor who demands perfect sleep, be refused, and leave the rotation running anyway.
Fold a famine-sized fear back down to lamb-size by feeding it properly for a year.
Attend a Drownsman's tally-reading in polite silence, and leave a lamb on the doorstep.

nodes.name: The Prior Road
nodes.role: Strategic mover — armies travel by sleep
nodes.lore: The histories quarrel politely over whether the last great Causewright built the road or uncovered it: the causeway somehow always beneath the others, the one survey-lines bend to agree with. Where the Prior Road walks, ways align — fords shallow, gates stand unbarred, and cities pave, not knowing why, along lines first walked asleep.
nodes.playstyle: Carry whole companies down your road through sleep; arrival, retreat, and supply are yours to schedule, and the ground keeps your itinerary.

abilities.name: March of the Sleeping Column
abilities.desc: Lead any number of sleepers — an army encamped — down your road; they wake where you decided, rested.

abilities.name: Alignment
abilities.desc: Roads, bridges, and doors within a day's walk agree with your route; travel against it sours.

abilities.name: The Road Was Here First
abilities.desc: Walls, wards, and fortifications standing across your road count as already breached; you walk through where it ran.

abilities.name: Milestones of the Deep
abilities.desc: Your waystones stand in every sleeper's dreaming; any ally asleep anywhere may step onto your road.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and walk a road so old it has no first map, and recognize your own staking-marks on it.
Move a beaten army home asleep in one night, and let the enemy chronicle call it weather.
Refuse to pave the way to somewhere that should stay far.

nodes.name: The Hundred Beds
nodes.role: Living sanctuary — war-stopping hospitality
nodes.lore: Past the hem stands an inn with a bed for every quarrel, and no waking door; you arrive by lying down angry somewhere else. Wars end there: opposing marshals keep waking rested, fed, and too embarrassed to order the assault. Two empires date their peace to a breakfast. Whether the Hundred Beds is keeper or house, guests never ask.
nodes.playstyle: Make the battle your house; combatants inside your walls become guests whether they meant to or not, and guest-law does the fighting.

abilities.name: Come In Out of the War
abilities.desc: Extend the house over the field; all within are guests, and violence indoors must argue with the walls first.

abilities.name: The Long Table
abilities.desc: Seat enemies at your table; while any bread remains on it, none may rise in anger.

abilities.name: Every Room Ready
abilities.desc: Fallen allies anywhere wake abed in the inn, tended, their wounds left at the door.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and host a war entire — both camps, asleep, under one roof — and serve breakfast until it is a former war.
Refuse a god a room, politely, on grounds of prior conduct.
Wake one morning unsure whether you built the inn or the inn grew you, and decline to check.

nodes.name: The Empty Mews
nodes.role: Terror-marshal — the night itself flies for you
nodes.lore: There is a mews at the roof of the deeps, and it stands empty, which is the whole horror of it: everything the Empty Mews ever broke is aloft. Always. Fears across seven kingdoms fly patrol-patterns and stoop to a whistle heard once a generation. Historians dispute whether the falconer still lives. The fears do not dispute anything.
nodes.playstyle: Command the sky of sleep; call broken terrors down anywhere night falls, stack their stoops, and keep nothing on the glove.

abilities.name: Everything Is Aloft
abilities.desc: Your broken terrors patrol wherever darkness or sleep exists; call any of them down, each round.

abilities.name: The Stoop
abilities.desc: A called terror dives one target, arriving with the weight of every night it has patrolled.

abilities.name: Heard Once
abilities.desc: Whistle: every fear on the field — yours, wild, or enemy-kept — checks its flight and looks to you.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and empty your mews for the last time; from now on, recall is a courtesy you extend, not a need.
Break a terror no Fewterer could course — one that hunted the hunters — and add its beat to the patrol.
Hang the hoods on the wall in size order. You will not need them. Oil them anyway; doctrine is doctrine.

nodes.name: The Quiet County
nodes.role: Purge incarnate — dread cannot exist near you
nodes.lore: There is a county where no bad dream has crossed a sill in thirty years, and the Drownsman who emptied it is now spoken of as a place. Historians argue the cost; the county sleeps through the argument. No one asks what the Quiet County carries instead.
nodes.playstyle: Extinguish; where you stand, fear-craft fails, horrors drown, and the night goes empty for miles — including, sometimes, of things your allies wanted kept.

abilities.name: Thirty Years' Practice
abilities.desc: Destroy any single fear, terror, or conjured horror outright; there is no size exception anymore.

abilities.name: County Line
abilities.desc: Draw the line; within it no dread can be born, summoned, loosed, or fed. It stays drawn.

abilities.name: What It Carries Instead
abilities.desc: Take a fear meant for an ally into yourself; it is never seen again, and neither is your comment.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and empty your county — however long it takes, however small the doors, however often the spring litters return.
Decline the statue. Suggest, instead, better shutters.
Keep the tallies in your head from now on. Some numbers should not be teachable.

nodes.name: The Drift
nodes.role: Untrackable assassin — arrives by no route
nodes.lore: Everyone knows the drift — the sideways slide at the hem, when the room seems to move. The trade has stopped pretending it is not somebody. The Drift is never where it was; what it carries arrives by no route, at addresses the maps gave up on. Causewrights concede, privately, that some country only the lost can cross.
nodes.playstyle: Be unfindable and inevitable; approach by no route, strike from the deep side of things, and leave pursuit holding a map of nowhere.

abilities.name: No Route Taken
abilities.desc: Arrive anywhere you have never been; wards, walls, and watchers cover every approach except yours.

abilities.name: Heading Unmade
abilities.desc: Enemies who pursue or aim at you lose their bearing; shots wander, and trackers find their own prints.

abilities.name: The Current Keeps It
abilities.desc: Drop a foe into the drift; they surface moments later, elsewhere, facing the wrong way, missing their advantage.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and deliver to an address that exists on no map of either country, and let the letter be your proof.
Be hunted by both halves of the Post at once, be found by neither, and deliver both their mails that night.
Forget your own way home, and find you no longer mind; the country keeps what travels light.

nodes.name: The Parlor
nodes.role: Arch-manipulator — the room that negotiates
nodes.lore: The age's great settlements were all reached in one parlor, though no two of its doors stand in the same country. The chairs are comfortable; the fire agrees with you; the tea is, somehow, your favorite. Guests leave having conceded what they arrived sworn to keep — grateful, and planning to return. Everyone walks in eventually.
nodes.playstyle: Fight in a room you own; enemies act under your hospitality, their choices gently pre-arranged, their exits subject to negotiation.

abilities.name: Will You Walk In
abilities.desc: Draw a foe into the parlor mid-battle; they return a moment later having agreed to something.

abilities.name: The Furniture Votes
abilities.desc: Terrain, cover, and footing within your influence favor whichever side you are currently fondest of.

abilities.name: Your Favorite
abilities.desc: Offer a foe the exact comfort they are starving for; refusing costs them will, accepting costs more.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and settle a succession war over tea, with neither claimant noticing the settlement until home.
Furnish the parlor with one honest chair, for your own use, and never let a guest sit in it.
Keep the kettle warm for whatever war arrives next; something always does.

nodes.name: The Followed
nodes.role: Pack legend — ancient terrors fight unbid
nodes.lore: Leashed nothing; earned everything. The Followed walks with a following nobody summoned: terrors old enough to have names in dead tongues, keeping to heel out of something older than fear. Towns that see them coming argue whether to bar the gates or bake. The wise do both.
nodes.playstyle: Give no orders and need none; your following guards, hunts, and avenges by its own ancient judgment, and it judges quickly.

abilities.name: Old Company
abilities.desc: Your earned terrors are always somewhere near; each battle, those best suited step forward unasked.

abilities.name: Older Than Fear
abilities.desc: Allies near you cannot be frightened; your following has standards about who does the frightening.

abilities.name: It Will Know
abilities.desc: Any hand raised against you is marked; somewhere in the following, something takes it personally.

abilities.name: Walk Unhunted
abilities.desc: Nothing in either country hunts you anymore; predators recognize the company you keep.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and come up out of the deeps followed by something no living Fewterer could name. Do not comment.
Let three towns call your arrival an omen, and disappoint all three; you are only walking.
Sleep once, deeply, in the middle of them all, and wake to find they kept the watch in shifts.

nodes.name: The Wandering Fold
nodes.role: Continental grazier — fear arrives as weather
nodes.lore: Each autumn a tide of small bad dreams crosses the continent, gentle as drizzle, gone by winter. Scholars file it under weather. Shepherds know a drive when they sleep through one. The Wandering Fold walks ahead of it — one keeper, ten thousand fears on rotation, fat, docile, and spoken for.
nodes.playstyle: Deploy dread at landscape scale; your flock arrives as weather, grazes a battle into exhaustion, and moves on before anything starves.

abilities.name: The Autumn Drive
abilities.desc: Bring the migration through the battlefield; every enemy is grazed small each round, gently, comprehensively.

abilities.name: Folded In
abilities.desc: Wild and enemy fears entering the field are folded into the flock; your rotation has room.

abilities.name: Gentle as Drizzle
abilities.desc: Your dreads cannot be noticed landing; victims count the cost only once it is prohibitive.

progressionSteps: Reach level 60 and take the continent on rotation: no town twice in a season, no fear unfed in a year.
Walk the drive through a war so that both armies oversleep an appointment with a massacre.
Refuse to sell the flock to a king who wants a weapon, and explain about famine until he stops wanting it.

nodes.name: The Way Through
nodes.role: World-road — every dreamt way is one way
nodes.lore: Every dream keeps ground underfoot and somewhere to walk. Sleepers assume this; it is not a law of nature. It is an office, and it is held. All dreamt roads are one road now, and everyone on any of them — the lost, the fleeing, the six-year-old crossing a nightmare — is on the Way Through, and known there.
nodes.playstyle: Be the way itself; anywhere anyone dreams you are already underfoot — arrive, carry, and deny passage as the ground pleases.

abilities.name: Already Underfoot
abilities.desc: Step out of any dream's road anywhere in the world; you were, technically, always there.

abilities.name: Known Traffic
abilities.desc: Learn who walks any dreamt road and whether they run toward or from; the fleeing may be delivered to you.

abilities.name: No Way for You
abilities.desc: Withdraw the road from one enemy everywhere; in dreams they stand in trackless dark, and waking journeys misgive.

abilities.name: Carried the Whole Way
abilities.desc: Any number of sleepers anywhere may be brought to one place by morning; the ground moves under them.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be walked on by the whole world for a year without once making yourself felt.
Keep the ground steady under a frightened child's nightmare, and under her mother's, the same hour, countries apart.
Let the Post argue for a century over which half of it you vindicate, and bear both their traffic without comment.

nodes.name: The Spare Room
nodes.role: Sanctuary absolute — the room always there
nodes.lore: Every house anyone dreams has one room more than it should. It stands at the top of the stairs, unlocked, and nothing hostile has ever crossed its sill. Hunted sleepers find it without being told. Architects, counting doors in the morning, have learned to stop at the number they built. The room is always made up for company.
nodes.playstyle: Be shelter itself; anyone, anywhere, on either side of sleep can be brought inside you, and inside has never once been breached.

abilities.name: Top of the Stairs
abilities.desc: Any creature fleeing may find your door; inside, no harm, hunger, or fear applies. You decide when morning comes.

abilities.name: Never Once
abilities.desc: The room cannot be breached, scried, burned, or believed away; sieges against it age poorly.

abilities.name: Made Up for Company
abilities.desc: Guests leave healed, rested, and quietly braver; the linens have opinions about despair.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and be the room for a stranger you dislike, exactly as warmly; the office does not ask.
Shelter the assassin and the target on the same night, and let them leave by different mornings.
Wait, made up and empty, through the good years when no one is hunted, without once wishing for guests.

nodes.name: The Recall
nodes.role: End of nightmares — all fear answers home
nodes.lore: Nightmares end. Sleepers assume the terror finishes with them; the truth is that something whistles it home. Every fear in either country — wild, kept, newborn, ancient — is subject to the Recall, knows it, and files the knowledge under obedience. The fist they return to is an office now. The glove is always worn.
nodes.playstyle: Command fear categorically; enemy terrors are yours mid-flight, panics disperse on a word, and anything frightening can be summoned to the glove.

abilities.name: Come to Heel
abilities.desc: End any fear, nightmare, or terror within your notice; it returns to the glove, spent and civil.

abilities.name: Mid-Flight
abilities.desc: Terrors loosed by others are redirected in the air; they complete their stoop for you instead.

abilities.name: The Glove Is Worn
abilities.desc: You cannot be frightened; whatever tries learns it has a falconer now.

abilities.name: General Recall
abilities.desc: Once per battle, whistle every fear in the region home; for one breath, all sleep nearby goes unhaunted.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and call home a fear that has run wild since before the trade had a name, and hang its hood.
Whistle once over a burning city and grant ten thousand sleepers one unhaunted night; take nothing for it.
Keep the mews empty and the hoods oiled; doctrine, at this altitude, is gentleness that keeps its gloves on.

nodes.name: The Lull
nodes.role: The empty night — nothing hunts at all
nodes.lore: Now and then a night comes when nothing hunts, anywhere: no mare crosses a sill, no terror stoops, every tally in the trade reads zero. Farmers call it good weather. The trade knows an office when it sleeps through one. The Lull is that emptiness held open on purpose — rest made a standing appointment the world cannot cancel.
nodes.playstyle: Impose the empty night; within your lull nothing hostile can act from fear, dark, or dream, and the stillness itself restores your own.

abilities.name: Reads Zero
abilities.desc: Within your lull, no fear, dread, or nightmare can exist, arrive, or be made. None.

abilities.name: Standing Appointment
abilities.desc: Declare tomorrow night empty across a region; all who sleep it heal double and wake unhauntable for a day.

abilities.name: Unplanted
abilities.desc: Ground you walk cannot grow ambushes, workings, or horrors for a season; it is resting.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and give the world one whole empty night — every sill, every camp, every cell — and take no credit.
Hold the lull over a besieged city so that, for one night, being surrounded is only geography.
Keep the gate of the empty night yourself; what was drowned to buy it stays drowned, and stays yours.

nodes.name: The Uncharted
nodes.role: Horizon of sleep — the unmapped, keeping itself
nodes.lore: The soft country cannot be finished. Surveys agree to within a night's walk of the edge, then stop agreeing; the blank quarters stay blank not for want of walkers but because something keeps them, the way a forest is kept. The Uncharted is why there is always a farther. Mapmakers of sleep leave their margins open now, on advice.
nodes.playstyle: Fight from off the map; you and yours act from country no chart contains, where nothing can follow, predict, or prepare.

abilities.name: Off the Edge
abilities.desc: You and chosen allies occupy unmapped country; targeting, scrying, and pursuit fail for lack of a where.

abilities.name: The Receding Farther
abilities.desc: Enemies advancing on you find the distance has opinions; approaches lengthen until intent is abandoned.

abilities.name: Unsurveyed
abilities.desc: Declare ground unsurveyed; effects that require knowing the terrain — traps, wards, ambushes — never knew it.

abilities.name: Somewhere New
abilities.desc: Once per battle, relocate the fight entire to country no one, including you, has ever seen.

progressionSteps: Reach level 85 and walk off every map of the dreaming at once, including the one you kept in your boot.
Keep one small blank for a young Sleepfarer to find, and be far away when they do, and be glad.
Decline, forever, to say what is out there — not because it is terrible, but because it is not yours to finish.

nodes.name: The Rooftree
nodes.role: Owner of indoors — all sleep one house
nodes.lore: There is no outdoors in sleep. The moors and seas and skies of the dreaming are rooms — spacious ones, handsomely kept — and rooms imply a ridge-beam, and every dreamt roof, followed up far enough, meets the same one. The Parlor's settlements never named a host. The Rooftree never needed naming; you were always under it.
nodes.playstyle: Fight indoors, always; walls arrive where you want them, doors open where you decide, and eviction is a question only your enemies face.

abilities.name: Under This Roof
abilities.desc: Declare one behavior forbidden indoors — flight, spellcraft, the harming of your guests — and indoors is everywhere.

abilities.name: Rearrangement
abilities.desc: Walls, stairs, and doors of the field move to your preference each round; guests adapt or are adapted.

abilities.name: Shown the Door
abilities.desc: Remove an enemy from the house; there being no outdoors, where they go is a question they now face.

abilities.name: Always Inside
